# Awesome 4D Gaussian Splatting

A concise, evidence-checked index of papers, project pages, code, and datasets for dynamic
Gaussian splatting.

This list uses **4DGS** broadly: native 4D Gaussian primitives, deformable or time-conditioned 3D
Gaussians, explicit Gaussian trajectories or sequences, and closely related dynamic Gaussian
representations. Of 347 listed arXiv papers, 325 are direct dynamic-Gaussian works, two are
supporting resources, and 20 are clearly labeled adjacent or historical references.

Every row keeps two or three reviewed contributions as a compact numbered list. Paper titles link
to arXiv, followed by available resources: a blue globe icon opens the project page, a green GitHub
icon marks a tree-inspected implementation, and a gray GitHub icon marks a placeholder or
documentation-only repository. Focused sections intentionally repeat papers when that makes a
section useful on its own.

## Reading guide

| If you are looking for... | Start with | What it covers |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Dynamic reconstruction and rendering | [Reconstruction](#dynamic-scene-reconstruction) | Per-scene reconstruction, native spacetime primitives, deformation, and dynamic novel-view synthesis |
| Limited observations | [Sparse reconstruction](#sparse-reconstruction) | Sparse-view, few-camera, two-image, and temporally sparse-frame reconstruction |
| New or controlled 4D content | [Generation and editing](#4d-generation-and-editing) | Generation, animation, simulation, editing, control, and composition |
| Smaller or faster systems | [Efficiency](#efficiency-compression-and-rendering) | Compression, codecs, streaming, memory reduction, fast training, and rendering |
| Generalizable inference | [Feed-forward 4DGS](#feed-forward-4dgs) | Methods that predict dynamic Gaussian representations without optimizing every scene from scratch |
| Motion and scene understanding | [Tracking, segmentation, and SLAM](#dynamic-tracking-segmentation-and-slam) | Persistent tracking, scene flow, segmentation, camera tracking, and dynamic mapping |
| People and articulated subjects | [Dynamic humans and avatars](#dynamic-humans-and-avatars) | Bodies, heads, hands, relighting, animation, and human-object interaction |
| Evaluation papers and data | [Benchmark papers](#dataset-and-benchmark-papers) and [datasets](#datasets) | Benchmark studies plus recurring monocular, multi-view, human, driving, and physics datasets |

Representation tags distinguish several common designs: `deformable-3dgs` uses canonical 3D
Gaussians with time-dependent deformation; `native-4dgs` gives primitives explicit spacetime
support; `explicit` stores trajectories, frames, or temporal bases directly; and `feed-forward`
predicts a representation without per-scene optimization. These tags overlap and describe design
choices rather than mutually exclusive paper families.

| [Implicit 4D Gaussian Splatting for Fast Motion with Large Inter-Frame Displacements](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.12362) (2026)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://seung-gyeom.github.io/SPIN-4DGS/ "Project page") [![Non-functional or unverified GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-8c959f?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/seung-gyeom/SPIN-4DGS "Placeholder or documentation-only GitHub repository")<br><sub>reconstruction &middot; per-scene &middot; native-4dgs &middot; explicit &middot; fast-motion</sub> | <ol><li>Learns Gaussian attributes from explicitly collected spatiotemporal positions instead of modeling temporal displacements.</li><li>Uses a lightweight feed-forward network under rasterization-based reconstruction loss to avoid optimizing attributes explicitly at every spatiotemporal position.</li><li>Shares representations across Gaussians to improve spatiotemporal consistency under large inter-frame motion.</li></ol> |
| [Grassmannian Splatting I: Moving rank-2 Spacetime Surfels for Dynamic Scene Rendering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10489) (2026)<br><br>[![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/PaulCelanCoding/grassmannian-splatting "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>reconstruction &middot; native-4dgs &middot; deformable-3dgs</sub> | <ol><li>Introduces Grassmannian splatting, whose Gaussian primitives lie on rank-three planes in spacetime and condition to rank-two surfels at each frame.</li><li>Encodes primitive orientation, normal velocity, disk shape, and tangential drift in a closed-form motion model without a learned deformation field.</li><li>Uses a standard 3DGS rasterizer.</li></ol> |
| [4D Human-Scene Reconstruction from Low-Overlap Captures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.09125) (2026)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://sisyphm.github.io/studiorecon-page/ "Project page")<br><sub>reconstruction &middot; multi-view &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; human</sub> | <ol><li>Reconstructs 4D human scenes from sparse, low-overlap cameras by decoupling background and humans.</li><li>Densifies background supervision by synthesizing hundreds of camera-controlled views with a video diffusion model.</li><li>Supports trajectory rendering and human replacement across four real-world datasets.</li></ol> |
| [On the Design of Mixture-of-Experts for Dynamic Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.08250) (2026)<br><br>[![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/cvsp-lab/MoDE "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>reconstruction &middot; per-scene &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; hybrid</sub> | <ol><li>Systematically studies mixture-of-experts designs for dynamic Gaussian deformation instead of treating the expert architecture as an implementation detail.</li><li>Jointly trains shared canonical experts to specialize in complementary motion patterns.</li><li>Introduces MoE-GS as a second design with independently trained experts and a learned router for combining their predictions.</li></ol> |
| [MVFusion-GS: Motion-Variance Guided Temporal Attention for High-Quality Dynamic Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.01578) (2026)<br><br><sub>reconstruction &middot; per-scene &middot; deformable-3dgs</sub> | <ol><li>Aggregates per-Gaussian deformation statistics over time to estimate motion variance and guide dynamic-static separation.</li><li>Applies temporal self-attention over neighboring timestamps to model local motion dependencies.</li></ol> |
| [Learning Efficient 4D Gaussian Representations from Monocular Videos with Flow Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29976) (2026)<br><br><sub>reconstruction &middot; monocular &middot; native-4dgs &middot; explicit &middot; fast-motion</sub> | <ol><li>Extends 4D volumes with time-varying Gaussian means and covariances and derives a velocity field from the representation.</li><li>Extends splatting to render camera-motion-aware optical flow, providing dense supervision for dynamics from monocular video.</li></ol> |
| [CoGS: Compositional Dynamic Human-Object Scenes Gaussian Splatting from Monocular Video](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.28820) (2026)<br><br><sub>reconstruction &middot; monocular &middot; driving &middot; human</sub> | <ol><li>Uses compositional Gaussian-splatting for monocular human--object scene reconstruction.</li><li>Decomposes each video into articulated-human, rigid-object, and static-scene Gaussian branches.</li></ol> |
| [Temporally Aware Densification for Dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23212) (2026)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://vikramsandu.github.io/publications/TADGS/index.html "Project page")<br><sub>reconstruction &middot; multi-view &middot; per-scene &middot; native-4dgs &middot; fast-motion</sub> | <ol><li>Introduces visibility-aware densification so Gaussians are refined according to their actual temporal presence.</li><li>Adjusts each Gaussian's densification threshold according to its temporal lifespan through temporally adaptive thresholding.</li><li>Uses temporal offset warping to increase deformation capacity near temporal centers and improve reconstruction of highly dynamic regions.</li></ol> |
| [Multi4D: High-Fidelity Dynamic Gaussian Splatting via Multi-Level Competitive Allocation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22197) (2026)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://batfacewayne.github.io/Multi4D.io/ "Project page")<br><sub>reconstruction &middot; per-scene &middot; hybrid &middot; tracking &middot; segmentation</sub> | <ol><li>Represents a dynamic scene with static, persistent, and transient Gaussian subsets tailored to different temporal behaviors.</li><li>Exposes persistent Gaussians as stable primitives for efficient segmentation and tracking in addition to novel-view synthesis.</li></ol> |
| [PersistGS: Differentiable Physics for Object Permanence in 4D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03479) (2026)<br><br><sub>reconstruction &middot; multi-view &middot; explicit &middot; physics-aware &middot; tracking</sub> | <ol><li>Couples per-object Gaussians and collision meshes to differentiable rigid-body simulation for fully occluded motion.</li><li>Estimates friction and velocity before occlusion and uses the simulated SE(3) trajectory to preserve object permanence.</li><li>Introduces a centroid-silhouette loss that isolates positional gradients from appearance noise.</li></ol> |
| [RiGS: Rigid-aware 4D Gaussian Splatting from a Single Monocular Video](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23672) (2026)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://ladvu.github.io/RiGS/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/ladvu/RiGS "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>reconstruction &middot; monocular &middot; per-scene &middot; native-4dgs &middot; fast-motion</sub> | <ol><li>Represents a scene with static, rigid, and transient Gaussian primitives for background, long-term motion, and short-term dynamics.</li><li>Uses an object-wise dynamic mask to aggregate long-range motion information and separate static from dynamic regions.</li><li>Optimizes rigid and transient primitives with scene-flow guidance to provide dense 3D motion supervision.</li></ol> |

| [GASPACHO: Gaussian Splatting for Controllable Humans and Objects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.09342) (2025)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://miraymen.github.io/gaspacho/ "Project page")<br><sub>reconstruction &middot; multi-view &middot; generation &middot; human &middot; physics-aware</sub> | <ol><li>Enables generating photorealistic, controllable renderings of human-object interactions from multi-view RGB video.</li><li>Introduces a formulation that learns object Gaussians on an underlying 2D surface manifold rather than in 3D volume.</li><li>GASPACHO simultaneously recovers animatable templates for both the human and the interacting object as distinct sets of Gaussians.</li></ol> |

| [Deblur4DGS: 4D Gaussian Splatting from Blurry Monocular Video](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.06424) (2024)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://deblur4dgs.github.io/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/ZcsrenlongZ/Deblur4DGS "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>reconstruction &middot; monocular &middot; per-scene &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; deblurring</sub> | <ol><li>Recasts continuous dynamic representation estimation within exposure time as exposure-time estimation.</li><li>Uses exposure, multi-frame, and multi-resolution consistency regularization to avoid trivial solutions.</li><li>Introduces blur-aware variable canonical Gaussians for objects with large motion.</li></ol> |

| [Motion-aware 3D Gaussian Splatting for Efficient Dynamic Scene Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.11447) (2024)<br><br>[![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/jasongzy/MAGS "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>reconstruction &middot; per-scene &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; tracking</sub> | <ol><li>Converts dense Gaussian correspondences into optical flow so learned 3D motion can be constrained by 2D observations.</li><li>Augments flow supervision with uncertainty handling and coordinated photometric and motion losses.</li><li>Uses an auxiliary transient-aware deformation pathway to improve reconstruction of rapidly changing content.</li></ol> |
| [ManiGaussian: Dynamic Gaussian Splatting for Multi-task Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.08321) (2024)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://guanxinglu.github.io/ManiGaussian/ "Project page")<br><sub>reconstruction &middot; segmentation &middot; human &middot; robotics</sub> | <ol><li>ManiGaussian mines scene dynamics via future scene reconstruction for multi-task robotic manipulation.</li><li>Formulates the dynamic Gaussian Splatting framework that infers the semantics propagation in the Gaussian embedding space, where the semantic representation is leveraged to predict the optimal robot action.</li><li>Builds a Gaussian world model to parameterize the distribution in the dynamic Gaussian Splatting framework, which provides informative supervision in the interactive environment via future scene reconstruction.</li></ol> |
| [4D-Rotor Gaussian Splatting: Towards Efficient Novel View Synthesis for Dynamic Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.03307) (2024)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://weify627.github.io/4drotorgs/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/weify627/4D-Rotor-Gaussians "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>reconstruction &middot; per-scene &middot; native-4dgs &middot; explicit &middot; fast-motion &middot; real-time</sub> | <ol><li>Represents dynamic content with anisotropic Gaussians directly in XYZT spacetime rather than deforming a canonical 3D cloud.</li><li>Parameterizes spatiotemporal rotations with rotors and slices 4D primitives into time-conditioned 3D Gaussians.</li><li>Captures complex motion in an explicit representation compatible with efficient real-time splatting.</li></ol> |
| [VR-GS: A Physical Dynamics-Aware Interactive Gaussian Splatting System in Virtual Reality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.16663) (2024)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://yingjiang96.github.io/VR-GS/ "Project page")<br><sub>reconstruction &middot; multi-view &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; real-time &middot; segmentation &middot; editing</sub> | <ol><li>Combines a two-level embedding with deformable-body simulation for real-time physics-aware interaction in VR.</li><li>Also incorporates real-time deformation embedding and dynamic shadow casting, ensuring a comprehensive and engaging virtual experience.</li></ol> |
| [EndoGS: Deformable Endoscopic Tissues Reconstruction with Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.11535) (2024)<br><br>[![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/HKU-MedAI/EndoGS "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>reconstruction &middot; monocular &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; robotics</sub> | <ol><li>Applies deformable Gaussian splatting to monocular endoscopic tissue reconstruction.</li><li>Combines deformation fields, depth-guided spatiotemporal masks, and surface-aligned regularization to handle tool occlusion and recover tissue geometry.</li></ol> |
| [Street Gaussians: Modeling Dynamic Urban Scenes with Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.01339) (2024)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://zju3dv.github.io/street_gaussians/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/zju3dv/street_gaussians "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>reconstruction &middot; driving &middot; explicit &middot; real-time &middot; editing</sub> | <ol><li>Models static backgrounds and moving vehicles as separate semantic Gaussian components in an urban scene.</li><li>Jointly optimizes tracked object poses and time-varying appearance to improve dynamic driving-scene reconstruction.</li><li>Supports real-time rendering and compositional manipulation such as adding, removing, or rearranging vehicles.</li></ol> |
| [Spacetime Gaussian Feature Splatting for Real-Time Dynamic View Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.16812) (2023)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://oppo-us-research.github.io/SpacetimeGaussians-website/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/oppo-us-research/SpacetimeGaussians "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>reconstruction &middot; per-scene &middot; explicit &middot; real-time &middot; compression</sub> | <ol><li>Extends 3D Gaussians with temporal opacity and parametric motion and rotation to represent static, dynamic, and transient content.</li><li>Uses splatted neural features instead of spherical harmonics for view- and time-dependent appearance.</li><li>Samples new Gaussians using training error and coarse-depth guidance in difficult regions.</li></ol> |
| [SWinGS: Sliding Windows for Dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.13308) (2023)<br><br><sub>reconstruction &middot; monocular &middot; multi-view &middot; per-scene &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; real-time</sub> | <ol><li>Splits long dynamic sequences into sliding temporal windows, each with a compact canonical Gaussian model and deformation network.</li><li>Adapts window duration to scene complexity to scale to arbitrarily long videos.</li><li>Fine-tunes neighboring windows for cross-window consistency while preserving real-time rendering.</li></ol> |
| [DrivingGaussian: Composite Gaussian Splatting for Surrounding Dynamic Autonomous Driving Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.07920) (2023)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://pkuvdig.github.io/DrivingGaussian/ "Project page") [![Non-functional or unverified GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-8c959f?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/VDIGPKU/DrivingGaussian "Placeholder or documentation-only GitHub repository")<br><sub>reconstruction &middot; driving &middot; multi-view &middot; explicit &middot; depth-prior</sub> | <ol><li>Reconstructs a large static street background incrementally to manage surrounding multi-camera driving sequences.</li><li>Represents moving objects with a composite dynamic Gaussian graph rather than mixing them into the background.</li><li>Uses LiDAR priors and panoramic consistency constraints for controllable, driving-scene synthesis.</li></ol> |
| [Gaussian-Flow: 4D Reconstruction with Dynamic 3D Gaussian Particle](https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.03431) (2023)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://nju-3dv.github.io/projects/Gaussian-Flow "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/NJU-3DV/Gaussian-Flow "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>reconstruction &middot; multi-view &middot; monocular &middot; per-scene &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; real-time</sub> | <ol><li>Introduces a dual-domain deformation model for per-Gaussian attribute deformations.</li><li>Models time-dependent attribute residuals with polynomial fitting in time and Fourier-series fitting in frequency.</li><li>Uses explicit deformation of discretized Gaussian points for dynamic reconstruction from multi-view and monocular video.</li></ol> |
| [Dynamic Gaussian Splatting from Markerless Motion Capture can Reconstruct Infants Movements](https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.19441) (2023)<br><br><sub>reconstruction &middot; tracking &middot; segmentation</sub> | <ol><li>Leverages semantic segmentation masks to focus on the infant, improving the initialization of the scene.</li><li>Uses the reconstructed dynamic Gaussians for novel-view rendering and infant-motion tracking.</li></ol> |
| [Real-time Photorealistic Dynamic Scene Representation and Rendering with 4D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.10642) (2023)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://fudan-zvg.github.io/4d-gaussian-splatting/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/fudan-zvg/4d-gaussian-splatting "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>reconstruction &middot; multi-view &middot; monocular &middot; per-scene &middot; native-4dgs &middot; real-time</sub> | <ol><li>Approximates a dynamic scene's spatiotemporal 4D volume with optimized 4D primitives having explicit geometry and appearance.</li><li>Parameterizes 4D Gaussians with anisotropic ellipses that rotate in space and time.</li><li>Models view-dependent, time-evolved appearance with coefficients of 4D spherical harmonics.</li></ol> |
| [4D Gaussian Splatting for Real-Time Dynamic Scene Rendering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.08528) (2023)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://guanjunwu.github.io/4dgs/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/hustvl/4DGaussians "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>reconstruction &middot; per-scene &middot; native-4dgs &middot; explicit &middot; real-time</sub> | <ol><li>Introduces a holistic dynamic-scene representation combining 3D Gaussians with 4D neural voxels.</li><li>Uses decomposed neural voxel encoding to construct Gaussian features from 4D neural voxels.</li><li>Uses a lightweight MLP to predict Gaussian deformations at timestamps.</li></ol> |
| [Deformable 3D Gaussians for High-Fidelity Monocular Dynamic Scene Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2309.13101) (2023)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://ingra14m.github.io/Deformable-Gaussians/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/ingra14m/Deformable-3D-Gaussians "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>reconstruction &middot; monocular &middot; per-scene &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; real-time</sub> | <ol><li>Learns 3D Gaussians in canonical space with a deformation field for monocular dynamic-scene reconstruction.</li><li>Introduces annealing smoothing during training to reduce the effect of inaccurate poses on time interpolation.</li><li>Uses a differential Gaussian rasterizer for high-quality, real-time dynamic rendering.</li></ol> |

## Sparse reconstruction

| Paper (arXiv) | Key contributions |
| --- | --- |
| [HiReFF: High-Resolution Feedforward Human Reconstruction from Uncalibrated Sparse-View Video](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29333) (2026)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://iridescentjiang.github.io/HiReFF "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/IridescentJiang/HiReFF "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>sparse-reconstruction &middot; multi-view &middot; sparse-view &middot; unposed &middot; feed-forward &middot; streaming</sub> | <ol><li>Uses feed-forward for 2K-resolution 360° human video reconstruction from uncalibrated sparse-view videos.</li><li>Decomposes the pipeline into foreground 3D Gaussian reconstruction from sparse-view videos (four views separated by 90°) and computationally efficient high-resolution synthesis.</li></ol> |
| [4C4D: 4 Camera 4D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.04063) (2026)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://junshengzhou.github.io/4C4D/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/yangzf-1023/4C4D "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>sparse-reconstruction &middot; sparse-view &middot; multi-view &middot; per-scene &middot; native-4dgs</sub> | <ol><li>Targets 4D Gaussian reconstruction from video captured by as few as four portable cameras.</li><li>Introduces a neural decaying function on Gaussian opacities to focus 4DGS gradients more strongly on geometry learning.</li><li>Addresses the geometry-versus-appearance learning imbalance in sparse-camera settings.</li></ol> |
| [UFO-4D: Unposed Feedforward 4D Reconstruction from Two Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.24290) (2026)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://ufo-4d.github.io/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/ufo-4d/ufo-4d "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>sparse-reconstruction &middot; feed-forward &middot; two-view &middot; unposed &middot; self-supervised &middot; explicit</sub> | <ol><li>Reconstructs a dense explicit 4D representation from two unposed images in a unified feed-forward framework.</li><li>Jointly estimates dynamic Gaussian geometry, 3D motion, and camera pose.</li><li>Renders multiple signals from shared Gaussians, coupling appearance, depth, and motion for self-supervised image-synthesis training.</li></ol> |
| [LoD-Structured 3D Gaussian Splatting for Streaming Video Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.18475) (2026)<br><br><sub>sparse-reconstruction &middot; sparse-view &middot; streaming &middot; real-time</sub> | <ol><li>Uses LoD-based Gaussian Splatting for SFVV.</li><li>Integrates three core innovations: 1) an Anchor- and Octree-based LoD-structured 3DGS with a hierarchical Gaussian dropout technique to ensure efficient and stable optimization while maintaining rendering; 2) a GMM-based motion partitioning mechanism.</li></ol> |
| [SV-GS: Sparse View 4D Reconstruction with Skeleton-Driven Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.00285) (2026)<br><br><sub>sparse-reconstruction &middot; monocular &middot; multi-view &middot; sparse-view &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; generation</sub> | <ol><li>Simultaneously estimates a deformation model and the object's motion over time under sparse observations.</li><li>Uses a rough skeleton graph and an initial static reconstruction to guide motion estimation under sparse observations.</li><li>Improves PSNR by up to 34% on synthetic sparse-view data and matches dense monocular-video methods on real data.</li></ol> |
| [DGGT: Feedforward 4D Reconstruction of Dynamic Driving Scenes using Unposed Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.03004) (2025)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://xiaomi-research.github.io/dggt/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/xiaomi-research/dggt "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>sparse-reconstruction &middot; feed-forward &middot; unposed &middot; sparse-view &middot; driving &middot; native-4dgs</sub> | <ol><li>Reformulates camera pose as a model output for pose-free, single-pass driving-scene reconstruction from sparse images.</li><li>Jointly predicts per-frame Gaussian maps and camera parameters, with dynamic and lifespan heads for motion and temporal visibility.</li></ol> |
| [Cross-Temporal 3D Gaussian Splatting for Sparse-View Guided Scene Update](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.00534) (2025)<br><br><sub>sparse-reconstruction &middot; sparse-view &middot; per-scene</sub> | <ol><li>Enables efficiently reconstructing and updating 3D scenes across different time periods, using sparse images and previously captured scene priors.</li><li>Supports non-continuous capture.</li></ol> |
| [Geometry-Consistent 4D Gaussian Splatting for Sparse-Input Dynamic View Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.23044) (2025)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://liyw420.github.io/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/liyw420/GC-4DGS "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>sparse-reconstruction &middot; multi-view &middot; sparse-view &middot; native-4dgs &middot; depth-prior</sub> | <ol><li>Detects dynamically inconsistent multi-view-stereo estimates before they corrupt sparse-input 4D reconstruction.</li><li>Regularizes geometry with global and local depth constraints derived from monocular depth predictions.</li></ol> |
| [Sparse4DGS: 4D Gaussian Splatting for Sparse-Frame Dynamic Scene Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.07122) (2025)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://changyueshi.github.io/Sparse4DGS/ "Project page")<br><sub>sparse-reconstruction &middot; per-scene &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; depth-prior &middot; sparse-frame</sub> | <ol><li>Targets dynamic reconstruction from temporally sparse frames, where large gaps make deformation estimation underconstrained.</li><li>Aligns texture and depth cues through texture-aware deformation regularization to stabilize motion between observed frames.</li><li>Uses texture-aware canonical optimization to preserve fine appearance while filling unobserved temporal intervals.</li></ol> |
| [Rigidity-Aware 3D Gaussian Deformation from a Single Image](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.22222) (2025)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://vision3d-lab.github.io/deformsplat/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/vision3d-lab/deformsplat "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>sparse-reconstruction &middot; sparse-view &middot; sparse-frame &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; editing</sub> | <ol><li>Recovers 3D Gaussian deformation from one target image by matching rendered Gaussian features to sparse 2D observations.</li><li>Segments and refines rigid parts to preserve geometric coherence during deformation.</li><li>Supports frame interpolation and interactive manipulation, with quantitative evaluation on DiVa-360 and Dynamic Furry Animal.</li></ol> |
| [Feed-Forward Bullet-Time Reconstruction of Dynamic Scenes from Monocular Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.03526) (2024)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://research.nvidia.com/labs/toronto-ai/bullet-timer/ "Project page")<br><sub>sparse-reconstruction &middot; feed-forward &middot; monocular &middot; native-4dgs &middot; real-time &middot; sparse-view</sub> | <ol><li>Introduces a motion-aware feed-forward model for bullet-time reconstruction and novel-view synthesis from casual monocular video.</li><li>Aggregates all context frames to reconstruct a 3D Gaussian scene at a selected target timestamp.</li><li>Uses a formulation intended to train across both static and dynamic scene datasets.</li></ol> |
| [Space-time 2D Gaussian Splatting for Accurate Surface Reconstruction under Complex Dynamic Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.18852) (2024)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://tb2-sy.github.io/st-2dgs/ "Project page")<br><sub>sparse-reconstruction &middot; monocular &middot; sparse-view &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; human</sub> | <ol><li>Introduces a space-time 2D Gaussian Splatting approach.</li><li>Learns canonical 2D Gaussian splats and deforms these 2D Gaussian splats while enforcing the disks of the Gaussian located on the surface of the objects.</li></ol> |
| [TOGS: Gaussian Splatting with Temporal Opacity Offset for Real-Time 4D DSA Rendering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.19586) (2024)<br><br>[![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/hustvl/TOGS "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>sparse-reconstruction &middot; sparse-view &middot; real-time</sub> | <ol><li>Introduces TOGS, a Gaussian splatting method with opacity offset over time, which can effectively improve the rendering quality and speed of 4D DSA.</li><li>Introduces an opacity offset table for each Gaussian to model the opacity offsets of the Gaussian, using these opacity-varying Gaussians to model the temporal variations in the radiance of the contrast agent.</li><li>By interpolating the opacity offset table, the opacity variation of the Gaussian at different time points can be determined.</li></ol> |

## 4D generation and editing

| Paper (arXiv) | Key contributions |
| --- | --- |
| [AniGS: Bridging Rendering and Diffusion Prior for 3D Scene Animation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.18539) (2026)<br><br><sub>generation &middot; deformable-3dgs</sub> | <ol><li>Enables scene-level animation of 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) reconstructions that adds subtle, distributed dynamics, e.g., vegetation motion, while preserving rigid structures.</li><li>Uses a pretrained video diffusion model and introduces an iterative dataset--model update strategy that progressively expands viewpoint coverage and repeatedly updates camera-fixed training videos using a render-and-refine scheme.</li><li>Produces natural ambient dynamics and view videos.</li></ol> |
| [CARLA-GS: Decoupling Representation, Reasoning, and Physics Simulation for Autonomous Driving Corner-Case Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.07601) (2026)<br><br><sub>generation &middot; editing &middot; segmentation &middot; driving &middot; physics-aware</sub> | <ol><li>CARLA-GS decouples visual representation, semantic reasoning, and physics-based execution while maintaining tight cross-module coupling.</li><li>Reconstructs an editable gaussian scene with additional geometry-consistent constraints from real driving data.</li></ol> |
| [Unified Panoramic-Gaussian Representation for Monocular 4D Scene Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.01663) (2026)<br><br><sub>generation &middot; monocular &middot; native-4dgs &middot; explicit</sub> | <ol><li>Reformulates monocular 4D synthesis as scene completion that must infer regions beyond observed-view interpolation.</li><li>Unifies training and inference through panoramic trajectory guidance to improve cross-view consistency under large viewpoint deviations.</li><li>Distills panoramic generative content into explicit dynamic Gaussians to preserve motion scale, shape, and other physical scene priors.</li></ol> |
| [World from Motion: Generative Dynamic Gaussian Reconstruction from Monocular Video](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.01202) (2026)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://research.nvidia.com/labs/amri/projects/world-from-motion/ "Project page")<br><sub>generation &middot; monocular &middot; multi-view &middot; deformable-3dgs</sub> | <ol><li>Enables generating freely renderable dynamic 3D Gaussian representations from monocular videos.</li><li>Builds a dataset of aligned multiview video pairs and dynamic 3DGS representations, with simulated artifacts characteristic of monocular reconstruction.</li><li>Conditions a video model on dense, pixel-aligned renderings that encode appearance, geometry, and 3D scene motion along both input and target camera trajectories to correct rendering artifacts and fill in missing regions.</li></ol> |
| [LUNA: Learning Universal 3D Human Animation Beyond Skinning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.31981) (2026)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://penghtyx.github.io/LUNA/ "Project page")<br><sub>generation &middot; monocular &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; driving &middot; human</sub> | <ol><li>Introduces LUNA, an LBS-free universal neural animation model that directly maps multiple 2D controls like images, keypoints, sketches, and unseen characters into 3D Gaussian deformations, bypassing explicit body fitting.</li><li>Introduces hybrid supervision that distills soft structural priors from an LBS teacher and a loss that supports training on both.</li></ol> |
| [MeGAS: Thermomechanical Dynamic Gaussian Splatting for Thermophysical Scene Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23455) (2026)<br><br><sub>generation &middot; editing &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; driving &middot; physics-aware</sub> | <ol><li>Incorporates thermomechanical phase-change dynamics into 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS).</li><li>Introduces a new thermomechanical dynamic Gaussian Splatting representation that augments 3DGS with temperature attributes and employs a heat advection-diffusion solver with MPM dynamics incorporating phase transitions.</li><li>Produces physically consistent thermomechanical behavior while maintaining photorealistic rendering, advancing toward physics-integrated world models.</li></ol> |
| [Edit3DGS: Unified Framework for Dynamic Head Editing via 2D Instruction-Guided Diffusion and 3D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.17432) (2026)<br><br><sub>generation &middot; multi-view &middot; editing &middot; segmentation &middot; human</sub> | <ol><li>Edit3DGS enables dynamic 3D head editing that integrates 2D instruction-guided diffusion with 3D Gaussian splatting.</li><li>Couples semantic controllability in the image domain with photorealistic, temporally consistent 3D representations.</li><li>Enables controllable, artifact-free head editing with smooth temporal transitions, offering practical applications in virtual avatars, immersive communication, film production, and interactive media.</li></ol> |
| [4D-GSW: Kinematic-Aware Spatio-Temporal Consistent Watermarking for 4D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.22342) (2026)<br><br><sub>generation &middot; native-4dgs &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; physics-aware</sub> | <ol><li>Introduces 4D-GSW, a kinematic-aware watermarking framework designed to embed robust copyright information while preserving high spatio-temporal consistency.</li><li>Introduces a Spatio-Temporal Curvature (STC) metric to identify "Dynamic Instants," adaptively gating watermark gradient injection to shield critical motion manifolds from non-physical perturbations.</li></ol> |
| [EndoGSim: Physics-Aware 4D Dynamic Endoscopic Scene Simulations via MLLM-Guided Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16022) (2026)<br><br><sub>generation &middot; native-4dgs &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; segmentation &middot; robotics</sub> | <ol><li>Achieves physics-aware reconstruction and physical simulation of endoscopic scenes through Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs)-guided Gaussian Splatting.</li><li>Introduces an object-wise material field that initializes material parameters via MLLM and refines them through a differentiable Material Point Method (MPM) under joint supervision from rendered.</li><li>Utilizes 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS) integrated with pre-trained segmentation and depth estimation to represent deformable tissues and tools.</li></ol> |
| [Habitat-GS: A High-Fidelity Navigation Simulator with Dynamic Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.12626) (2026)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://zju3dv.github.io/habitat-gs/ "Project page")<br><sub>generation &middot; real-time &middot; human</sub> | <ol><li>Introduces Habitat-GS, a navigation-centric embodied AI simulator extended from Habitat-Sim that integrates 3D Gaussian Splatting scene rendering and drivable gaussian avatars while maintaining full compatibility with the Habitat ecosystem.</li><li>A gaussian avatar module that enables each avatar to simultaneously serve as a photorealistic visual entity and an effective navigation obstacle.</li><li>Agents trained on 3DGS scenes achieve stronger cross-domain generalization, with mixed-domain training being the most effective strategy.</li></ol> |
| [AvatarPointillist: AutoRegressive 4D Gaussian Avatarization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.04787) (2026)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://kumapowerliu.github.io/AvatarPointillist/ "Project page")<br><sub>generation &middot; monocular &middot; feed-forward &middot; human &middot; native-4dgs</sub> | <ol><li>Generates a dynamic Gaussian avatar from a single portrait with a decoder-only autoregressive Transformer that emits an adaptive point cloud.</li><li>Jointly predicts per-point binding information for animation, then decodes complete Gaussian attributes from the generated points.</li><li>Conditions the Gaussian decoder on autoregressive latent features to improve avatar fidelity.</li></ol> |
| [Dynamic-eDiTor: Training-Free Text-Driven 4D Scene Editing with Multimodal Diffusion Transformer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.00677) (2025)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://di-lee.github.io/dynamic-eDiTor/ "Project page")<br><sub>generation &middot; multi-view &middot; editing &middot; native-4dgs &middot; driving &middot; large-model</sub> | <ol><li>Dynamic-eDiTor leverages Multimodal Diffusion Transformer (MM-DiT) and 4DGS.</li><li>This mechanism consists of Spatio-Temporal Sub-Grid Attention (STGA) for locally consistent cross-view and temporal fusion, and Context Token Propagation (CTP) for global propagation via token inheritance and optical-flow-guided token replacement.</li></ol> |
| [4DGS-Craft: Consistent and Interactive 4D Gaussian Splatting Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.01991) (2025)<br><br><sub>generation &middot; multi-view &middot; editing &middot; native-4dgs &middot; human</sub> | <ol><li>Introduces 4DGS-Craft, a consistent and interactive 4DGS editing framework.</li><li>Enhances this model with a multi-view grid module that enforces consistency by iteratively refining multi-view input images while jointly optimizing the underlying 4D scene.</li><li>Firsts introduce a 4D-aware InstructPix2Pix model to ensure both view and temporal consistency.</li></ol> |
| [WorldSplat: Gaussian-Centric Feed-Forward 4D Scene Generation for Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.23402) (2025)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://wm-research.github.io/worldsplat/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/xiaomi-research/worldsplat "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>generation &middot; feed-forward &middot; driving &middot; native-4dgs &middot; multi-view</sub> | <ol><li>Introduces a feed-forward framework for generating 4D driving scenes with Gaussian-centric representations.</li><li>Uses a multimodal 4D-aware latent diffusion model to produce pixel-aligned 4D Gaussians.</li><li>Refines Gaussian-rendered novel-view videos with a video diffusion model for spatially and temporally consistent multi-track outputs.</li></ol> |
| [Every Camera Effect, Every Time, All at Once: 4D Gaussian Ray Tracing for Physics-based Camera Effect Data Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.10759) (2025)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://shigon255.github.io/4DGRT-project-page/ "Project page")<br><sub>generation &middot; multi-view &middot; native-4dgs &middot; physics-aware &middot; synthetic</sub> | <ol><li>4D Gaussian Ray Tracing (4D-GRT) combines 4D Gaussian Splatting with physically-based ray tracing for camera effect simulation.</li><li>Constructs eight synthetic dynamic scenes in indoor environments across four camera effects as a benchmark to evaluate generated videos with camera effects.</li></ol> |
| [BulletGen: Improving 4D Reconstruction with Bullet-Time Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.18601) (2025)<br><br><sub>generation &middot; monocular &middot; native-4dgs &middot; tracking</sub> | <ol><li>Takes advantage of generative models to correct errors and complete missing information in a Gaussian-based dynamic scene representation.</li><li>Blends generative content with both static and dynamic scene components, achieving results on both novel-view synthesis, and 2D/3D tracking tasks.</li><li>This is done by aligning the output of a diffusion-based video generation model with the 4D reconstruction at a single frozen "bullet-time" step.</li></ol> |
| [Generative 4D Scene Gaussian Splatting with Object View-Synthesis Priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.12716) (2025)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://genmojo.github.io/ "Project page")<br><sub>generation &middot; monocular &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; human</sub> | <ol><li>Combines deformable 3DGS optimization with object-view-synthesis priors to generate multi-object 4D scenes from occluded monocular video.</li><li>To address this, GenMOJO decomposes the scene into individual objects, optimizing a differentiable set of deformable Gaussians per object.</li><li>This object-wise decomposition allows leveraging object-centric diffusion models to infer unobserved regions in viewpoints.</li></ol> |
| [WeatherEdit: Controllable Weather Editing with 4D Gaussian Field](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.20471) (2025)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://jumponthemoon.github.io/w-edit "Project page")<br><sub>generation &middot; multi-view &middot; editing &middot; native-4dgs &middot; driving</sub> | <ol><li>Uses weather editing for generating realistic weather effects with controllable types and severity in 3D scenes.</li><li>An all-in-one adapter that integrates multiple weather styles into a single pretrained diffusion model.</li><li>WeatherEdit can generate diverse weather effects with controllable condition severity, highlighting its potential for autonomous driving simulation in adverse weather.</li></ol> |
| [HoloTime: Taming Video Diffusion Models for Panoramic 4D Scene Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.21650) (2025)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://zhouhyocean.github.io/holotime/ "Project page")<br><sub>generation &middot; native-4dgs</sub> | <ol><li>Integrates video diffusion models to generate panoramic videos from a single prompt or reference image, along with a 360-degree 4D scene reconstruction method.</li><li>Introduces the 360World dataset, the first comprehensive collection of panoramic videos suitable for downstream 4D scene reconstruction tasks.</li><li>Introduces Panoramic Animator, a two-stage image-to-video diffusion model that can convert panoramic images into panoramic videos.</li></ol> |
| [3D Dynamic Fluid Assets from Single-View Videos with Generative Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.00868) (2025)<br><br><sub>generation &middot; monocular &middot; editing &middot; physics-aware</sub> | <ol><li>Uses generative 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) models to extract and re-simulate 3D dynamic fluid objects from single-view videos using simulation methods.</li><li>The fluid geometry represented by 3DGS is initially generated and optimized from single-view images, then denoised, densified, and aligned across frames.</li><li>Estimates the fluid surface velocity using optical flow, propose a mainstream extraction algorithm to refine it.</li></ol> |
| [Instruct-4DGS: Efficient Dynamic Scene Editing via 4D Gaussian-based Static-Dynamic Separation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.02091) (2025)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://hanbyelcho.info/instruct-4dgs/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/juhyeon-kwon/Instruct-4DGS "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>generation &middot; editing &middot; per-scene &middot; deformable-3dgs</sub> | <ol><li>Separates static and dynamic Gaussian content so text-guided edits can be applied to the canonical static representation.</li><li>Uses score-distillation guidance without repeatedly editing every video frame.</li><li>Adds temporal refinement to correct deformation-induced misalignment and propagate coherent edits through time.</li></ol> |
| [DreamMesh4D: Video-to-4D Generation with Sparse-Controlled Gaussian-Mesh Hybrid Representation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.06756) (2024)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://lizhiqi49.github.io/DreamMesh4D "Project page")<br><sub>generation &middot; monocular &middot; editing &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; driving</sub> | <ol><li>DreamMesh4D combines mesh representation with geometric skinning technique to generate 4D object from a monocular video.</li><li>Binds Gaussian splats to triangle face of mesh for differentiable optimization of both the texture and mesh vertices.</li></ol> |
| [GSTalker: Real-time Audio-Driven Talking Face Generation via Deformable Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.19040) (2024)<br><br><sub>generation &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; real-time &middot; driving &middot; human</sub> | <ol><li>Trains in 40 minutes and renders audio-driven talking faces at 125 FPS from a short person-specific video.</li><li>Uses an audio-driven Gaussian deformation field with multi-resolution hash-grid tri-planes and temporal smoothing.</li></ol> |
| [STAG4D: Spatial-Temporal Anchored Generative 4D Gaussians](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.14939) (2024)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://nju-3dv.github.io/projects/STAG4D/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/zeng-yifei/STAG4D "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>generation &middot; monocular &middot; per-scene &middot; deformable-3dgs</sub> | <ol><li>Initializes 4D generation with multi-view diffusion applied to input video frames and anchors temporal self-attention to the first frame for consistency.</li><li>Optimizes a dynamic Gaussian point cloud with score distillation and an adaptive densification strategy designed to stabilize Gaussian gradients.</li><li>Accepts text, image, or video inputs without training or fine-tuning the underlying diffusion networks.</li></ol> |
| [GaussianFlow: Splatting Gaussian Dynamics for 4D Content Creation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.12365) (2024)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://zerg-overmind.github.io/GaussianFlow.github.io/ "Project page")<br><sub>generation &middot; per-scene &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; editing</sub> | <ol><li>Introduces Gaussian flow, connecting 3D Gaussian dynamics to pixel velocities between consecutive frames.</li><li>Obtains Gaussian flow by splatting Gaussian dynamics into image space.</li><li>Targets 4D generation and novel-view synthesis, including reduced color drifting in 4D generation.</li></ol> |
| [DreamGaussian4D: Generative 4D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.17142) (2023)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://jiawei-ren.github.io/projects/dreamgaussian4d/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/jiawei-ren/dreamgaussian4d "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>generation &middot; monocular &middot; per-scene &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; fast-training</sub> | <ol><li>Builds image-to-4D content by generating a static Gaussian model with DreamGaussianHD and then optimizing HexPlane-driven Gaussian deformation.</li><li>Refines UV-space texture maps with a pretrained image-to-video diffusion model to improve detail and temporal consistency.</li><li>Reduces per-asset optimization to minutes, supports visual motion control, and exports animated meshes for conventional 3D engines.</li></ol> |
| [SC-GS: Sparse-Controlled Gaussian Splatting for Editable Dynamic Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.14937) (2023)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://yihua7.github.io/SC-GS-web/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/CVMI-Lab/SC-GS "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>generation &middot; per-scene &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; editing &middot; explicit</sub> | <ol><li>Decomposes dynamic-scene motion and appearance into sparse control points and dense Gaussians.</li><li>Learns compact 6-DoF transformation bases that are interpolated locally to produce Gaussian motion fields.</li><li>Adapts control-point locations and counts and applies an ARAP loss for spatial continuity and local rigidity.</li></ol> |

## Efficiency, compression, and rendering

| Paper (arXiv) | Key contributions |
| --- | --- |
| [GrainGS: Gradient-Decoupled Gaussian Splatting for Efficient Dynamic Novel View Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.21448) (2026)<br><br>[![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/I2-Multimedia-Lab/GrainGS "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>efficiency &middot; monocular &middot; multi-view &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; real-time &middot; synthetic</sub> | <ol><li>GrainGS combines a hierarchical anchor scaffold with per-Gaussian deformation.</li><li>A static warm-up stage first establishes a time-invariant canonical representation from observations across all timestamps.</li></ol> |
| [LentiAvatar: Pseudo-Multiview Reconstruction and Subpixel Prism Rendering for Real-Time Stereoscopic Communication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.10550) (2026)<br><br><sub>efficiency &middot; monocular &middot; multi-view &middot; real-time &middot; driving &middot; human</sub> | <ol><li>LentiAvatar connects monocular avatar capture with subpixel-encoded glasses-free lenticular display for real-time autostereoscopic communication.</li><li>From a monocular portrait video, LentiAvatar reconstructs a controllable head avatar and optimizes it for the lateral viewing zones induced by the display.</li><li>Uses natural head turns as pseudo-multiview (PMV) supervision to constrain regions that are otherwise weakly observed in monocular training, including hair, ears, jaw contours, and neck boundaries.</li></ol> |
| [DSD-GS: Dynamic-Static Decomposition of Gaussian Splatting for Efficient and High-Fidelity Dynamic Scene Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30863) (2026)<br><br><sub>efficiency &middot; feed-forward &middot; generation &middot; robotics</sub> | <ol><li>Introduces a dynamic reconstruction framework built upon an efficient static-dynamic decomposition strategy using a Feed-Forward Gaussian Splatting encoder and an optical flow model.</li><li>Trains in 10 minutes and renders at over 700 FPS on a single NVIDIA RTX 5090 GPU at resolution of 1352x1014 on the Neural 3D dataset.</li></ol> |
| [PD-4DGS:Progressive Decomposition of 4D Gaussian Splatting for Bandwidth-Adaptive Dynamic Scene Streaming](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.11427) (2026)<br><br><sub>efficiency &middot; per-scene &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; streaming &middot; compression</sub> | <ol><li>Decomposes 4DGS into independently transmittable static-scaffold, global-deformation, and local-refinement layers whose prefixes remain renderable.</li><li>Combines Gaussian-entropy rate-distortion training, temporal mask consistency, and activation-gated capacity rollout for progressive coding.</li><li>Over 60% bitstream reduction at matched fidelity and about 1.7-second first-frame latency over a 2 Mbps link.</li></ol> |
| [CAGS: Color-Adaptive Volumetric Video Streaming with Dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.09279) (2026)<br><br>[![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/yindaheng98/ColorAdaptiveGaussianSplatting "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>efficiency &middot; multi-view &middot; compression &middot; streaming &middot; real-time</sub> | <ol><li>Constructs scalable Gaussian levels of detail with vector quantization and corrects compression-induced color distortion using low-resolution reference images.</li><li>Implements adaptive server-client volumetric streaming by rendering references on the server and restoring color on the client.</li><li>Handles fluctuating bandwidth and generalizes across multiple Gaussian representations.</li></ol> |
| [Fast and Robust Deformable 3D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.20857) (2026)<br><br><sub>efficiency &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; real-time</sub> | <ol><li>Uses efficient and robust for dynamic scene reconstruction.</li><li>These methods maintain 3D Gaussian attributes in a canonical field and employ the deformation field to transform this field across temporal sequences.</li><li>FRoG integrates per-Gaussian embedding with a coarse-to-fine temporal embedding strategy, accelerating rendering through the early fusion of temporal embeddings.</li></ol> |
| [Does it matter which Gaussians you pick in 4D Gaussian streaming?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.17227) (2026)<br><br><sub>efficiency &middot; streaming &middot; native-4dgs &middot; editing &middot; driving</sub> | <ol><li>Wills release the full sweep and evaluation protocol as a sampler benchmark.</li><li>Because these anchors act as control points that drive the whole scene through linear blend skinning, the rule used to choose them ought to affect reconstruction quality.</li></ol> |
| [PackUV: Packed Gaussian UV Maps for 4D Volumetric Video](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.23040) (2026)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://ivl.cs.brown.edu/packuv/ "Project page") [![Non-functional or unverified GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-8c959f?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/aashishrai3799/packuv "Placeholder or documentation-only GitHub repository")<br><sub>efficiency &middot; multi-view &middot; explicit &middot; compression &middot; streaming &middot; fast-motion</sub> | <ol><li>Maps Gaussian attributes into structured multi-scale UV atlases for compact, image-native storage compatible with conventional video codecs.</li><li>Uses flow-guided Gaussian labeling and video keyframing to stabilize static regions and maintain temporal coherence under large motion and disocclusion.</li><li>Introduces PackUV-2B, a 100-sequence, two-billion-frame multi-view dataset, and demonstrates consistent reconstruction on videos up to 30 minutes.</li></ol> |
| [HPC: Hierarchical Point-based Latent Representation for Streaming Dynamic Gaussian Splatting Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.00671) (2026)<br><br><sub>efficiency &middot; multi-view &middot; hybrid &middot; compression &middot; streaming</sub> | <ol><li>Uses a hierarchical point-based latent representation with per-Gaussian support and local aggregation to avoid empty-space redundancy.</li><li>Compresses both temporal latent features and inter-frame neural-network parameters in a unified end-to-end framework.</li><li>Reduces storage by 67 percent against its baseline while maintaining high reconstruction fidelity.</li></ol> |
| [AirGS: Real-Time 4D Gaussian Streaming for Free-Viewpoint Video Experiences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.20943) (2025)<br><br><sub>efficiency &middot; multi-view &middot; streaming &middot; compression &middot; fast-training &middot; real-time</sub> | <ol><li>Converts Gaussian video streams into multi-channel 2D formats and selects key frames to stabilize long-sequence reconstruction.</li><li>Combines temporal coherence with an inflation loss to reduce training time and representation size.</li><li>Formulates delivery as integer linear programming and selects pruning levels online to balance reconstruction quality against bandwidth.</li></ol> |
| [HGS: Hybrid Gaussian Splatting with Static-Dynamic Decomposition for Compact Dynamic View Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.14352) (2025)<br><br><sub>efficiency &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; real-time &middot; large-model</sub> | <ol><li>Introduces Hybrid Gaussian Splatting (HGS), a compact and efficient framework explicitly designed to disentangle static and dynamic regions.</li><li>The core innovation of HGS lies in the Static-Dynamic Decomposition (SDD) strategy, which leverages Radial Basis Function (RBF) modeling for Gaussian primitives.</li><li>Reduces model size by up to 98% and achieves real-time rendering at up to 125 FPS at 4K resolution on a single RTX 3090 GPU.</li></ol> |
| [TED-4DGS: Temporally Activated and Embedding-based Deformation for 4DGS Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.05446) (2025)<br><br><sub>efficiency &middot; compression &middot; native-4dgs &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; editing</sub> | <ol><li>Introduces TED-4DGS, a temporally activated and embedding-based deformation scheme for rate-distortion-optimized 4DGS compression that unifies the strengths of both families.</li><li>TED-4DGS is built on a sparse anchor-based 3DGS representation.</li><li>Each canonical anchor is assigned learnable temporal-activation parameters to specify its appearance and disappearance transitions over time, while a lightweight per-anchor temporal embedding queries a shared deformation bank to produce anchor-specific deformation.</li></ol> |
| [Alias-free 4D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.18367) (2025)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://4d-alias-free.github.io/4D-Alias-free/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/czl-gif/4daa "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>efficiency &middot; per-scene &middot; native-4dgs &middot; multi-view &middot; monocular</sub> | <ol><li>Derives a maximum sampling-frequency formulation for 4D Gaussian Splatting.</li><li>Introduces a 4D scale-adaptive filter and scale loss to regulate sampling frequency across rendering scales.</li><li>Reduces high-frequency artifacts and redundant Gaussians in monocular and multi-view video reconstruction.</li></ol> |
| [StreamSTGS: Streaming Spatial and Temporal Gaussian Grids for Real-Time Free-Viewpoint Video](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.06046) (2025)<br><br>[![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/kkkzh/StreamSTGS "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>efficiency &middot; multi-view &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; compression &middot; streaming &middot; real-time</sub> | <ol><li>Represents dynamic free-viewpoint video with canonical 3D Gaussians, temporal features, and a deformation field.</li><li>Encodes Gaussian attributes as images and temporal features as video.</li><li>Combines sliding-window local-motion learning with transformer-guided global-motion supervision.</li></ol> |
| [P-4DGS: Predictive 4D Gaussian Splatting with 90× Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.10030) (2025)<br><br><sub>efficiency &middot; compression &middot; explicit &middot; real-time</sub> | <ol><li>Predicts spatiotemporal Gaussian attributes from compact anchors to reduce redundant parameters across space and time.</li><li>Combines adaptive quantization with contextual entropy coding for end-to-end compression of dynamic Gaussian scenes.</li><li>Roughly one-megabyte representations and up to 90-fold compression on real-world sequences while preserving rendering quality.</li></ol> |
| [DEGS: Deformable Event-based 3D Gaussian Splatting from RGB and Event Stream](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.07752) (2025)<br><br><sub>efficiency &middot; streaming &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; deblurring &middot; synthetic</sub> | <ol><li>Jointly optimizes dynamic 3DGS from the two modalities.</li><li>Uses event motion priors to guide the optimization of the deformation fields.</li></ol> |
| [Optimized Minimal 4D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.03857) (2025)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://minshirley.github.io/OMG4/ "Project page")<br><sub>efficiency &middot; compression &middot; native-4dgs &middot; real-time &middot; human</sub> | <ol><li>Constructs a compact set of salient Gaussians for faithfully representing 4D Gaussian models.</li><li>Progressively prunes Gaussians in three stages: (1) Gaussian Sampling to identify primitives critical to reconstruction fidelity, (2) Gaussian Pruning to remove redundancies, and (3) Gaussian Merging to fuse primitives with similar characteristics.</li><li>Reduces model sizes by over 60% while maintaining reconstruction quality.</li></ol> |
| [Instant4D: 4D Gaussian Splatting in Minutes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.01119) (2025)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://instant4d.github.io/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Zhanpeng1202/Instant4D "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>efficiency &middot; monocular &middot; unposed &middot; native-4dgs &middot; fast-training &middot; slam</sub> | <ol><li>Introduces a native 4D representation for reconstructing uncalibrated casual monocular video.</li><li>Uses deep visual SLAM for geometric recovery and grid pruning to reduce representation redundancy.</li><li>Streamlines 4D Gaussian modeling to accelerate temporal reconstruction and reduce model size.</li></ol> |
| [ReCon-GS: Continuum-Preserved Gaussian Streaming for Fast and Compact Reconstruction of Dynamic Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.24325) (2025)<br><br>[![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/jyfu-vcl/ReCon-GS "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>efficiency &middot; streaming &middot; online &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; real-time</sub> | <ol><li>Introduces the Reconfigurable Continuum Gaussian Stream, dubbed ReCon-GS, a storage-aware framework that enables high fidelity online dynamic scene reconstruction and real-time rendering.</li><li>Dynamicallies allocate multi-level Anchor Gaussians in a density-adaptive fashion to capture inter-frame geometric deformations.</li><li>That, compared to methods, ReCon-GS improves training efficiency by approximately 15% and achieves FVV synthesis quality with enhanced robustness and stability.</li></ol> |
| [4DGCPro: Efficient Hierarchical 4D Gaussian Compression for Progressive Volumetric Video Streaming](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.17513) (2025)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://mediax-sjtu.github.io/4DGCPro/ "Project page") [![Non-functional or unverified GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-8c959f?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/MediaX-SJTU/4DGCPro "Placeholder or documentation-only GitHub repository")<br><sub>efficiency &middot; multi-view &middot; native-4dgs &middot; compression &middot; streaming &middot; real-time</sub> | <ol><li>Builds a perceptually weighted hierarchical 4D Gaussian representation with motion-aware grouping for progressive multi-level streaming from one bitstream.</li><li>Jointly optimizes hierarchy layers with rate-distortion supervision and attribute-specific entropy models.</li><li>Supports flexible bitrates with real-time mobile decoding and rendering while preserving temporal coherence.</li></ol> |
| [4D-MoDe: Towards Editable and Scalable Volumetric Streaming via Motion-Decoupled 4D Gaussian Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.17506) (2025)<br><br>[![Non-functional or unverified GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-8c959f?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/MediaX-SJTU/4D-MoDe "Placeholder or documentation-only GitHub repository")<br><sub>efficiency &middot; multi-view &middot; native-4dgs &middot; compression &middot; streaming &middot; editing</sub> | <ol><li>Separates static backgrounds from dynamic foregrounds with lookahead motion decomposition, reducing temporal redundancy and enabling selective streaming.</li><li>Combines a multi-resolution motion grid, shared MLP, dynamic Gaussian compensation, and adaptive background keyframes.</li><li>Jointly optimizes motion and Gaussian parameters for rate-distortion and supports background replacement and foreground-only streaming.</li></ol> |
| [Topology-Aware Optimization of Gaussian Primitives for Human-Centric Volumetric Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.07653) (2025)<br><br>[![Non-functional or unverified GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-8c959f?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/HiFi-Human/TaoGS "Placeholder or documentation-only GitHub repository")<br><sub>efficiency &middot; compression &middot; tracking &middot; human &middot; physics-aware</sub> | <ol><li>Introduces TaoGS, a topology-aware dynamic Gaussian representation that disentangles motion and appearance to support, both, long-range tracking and topological adaptation.</li><li>Introduces a global Gaussian Lookup Table that records the lifespan of each Gaussian and organizes attributes into a lifespan-aware 2D layout.</li><li>Represents scene motion with a sparse set of motion Gaussians, which are continuously updated by a spatio-temporal tracker and photometric cues that detect structural variations across frames.</li></ol> |

| [MoDec-GS: Global-to-Local Motion Decomposition and Temporal Interval Adjustment for Compact Dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.03714) (2025)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://kaist-viclab.github.io/MoDecGS-site/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/skwak-kaist/MoDec-GS "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>efficiency &middot; per-scene &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; compression &middot; real-time</sub> | <ol><li>Decomposes motion into a global canonical scaffold for coarse movement and local Gaussian deformation for fine details.</li><li>Introduces temporal interval adjustment so motion parameters are allocated where scene dynamics require them.</li><li>Reduces model size while preserving reconstruction quality and real-time rendering.</li></ol> |

| [QUEEN: QUantized Efficient ENcoding of Dynamic Gaussians for Streaming Free-viewpoint Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.04469) (2024)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://research.nvidia.com/labs/amri/projects/queen/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/NVlabs/QUEEN "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>efficiency &middot; multi-view &middot; online &middot; streaming &middot; compression &middot; real-time</sub> | <ol><li>Encodes a dynamic sequence as Gaussian-attribute residuals between consecutive frames instead of retransmitting complete representations.</li><li>Quantizes non-position attributes with a latent decoder and sparsifies position residuals with learned gating.</li><li>Uses view-space gradient changes to identify dynamic content, reporting about 0.7 MB per frame, under five-second training, and 350 FPS rendering.</li></ol> |
