| [HiCoM: Hierarchical Coherent Motion for Streamable Dynamic Scene with 3D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.07541) (2024)<br><br>[![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/gqk/HiCoM "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>efficiency &middot; multi-view &middot; online &middot; streaming &middot; compression &middot; fast-training</sub> | <ol><li>Builds a compact initial representation with perturbation smoothing, then learns nonuniform motion through hierarchical local Gaussian coherence.</li><li>Merges newly added Gaussians into the representation while removing an equal number of low-opacity primitives to constrain stream size.</li><li>About 85% lower storage, roughly 20% higher learning efficiency, and under two seconds per frame with parallel processing.</li></ol> |
| [Fully Explicit Dynamic Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.15629) (2024)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://leejunoh.com/Ex4DGS/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/juno181/Ex4DGS "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>efficiency &middot; per-scene &middot; explicit &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; fast-training</sub> | <ol><li>Separates static and dynamic Gaussians and explicitly samples dynamic positions and rotations at sparse timestamps.</li><li>Interpolates sampled attributes to model spatially and temporally continuous object motion with lower cost.</li><li>Uses progressive training and point backtracking to improve convergence and remove erroneous Gaussians.</li></ol> |
| [MEGA: Memory-Efficient 4D Gaussian Splatting for Dynamic Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.13613) (2024)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://xinjie-q.github.io/MEGA "Project page") [![Non-functional or unverified GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-8c959f?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Xinjie-Q/MEGA "Placeholder or documentation-only GitHub repository")<br><sub>efficiency &middot; per-scene &middot; native-4dgs &middot; compression &middot; explicit</sub> | <ol><li>Replaces high-dimensional per-Gaussian spherical-harmonic color attributes with direct color and a shared lightweight color predictor.</li><li>Introduces entropy-constrained Gaussian deformation and opacity-based entropy loss to limit Gaussian count.</li><li>Combines the representation with half-precision storage and zip compression.</li></ol> |
| [V^3: Viewing Volumetric Videos on Mobiles via Streamable 2D Dynamic Gaussians](https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.13648) (2024)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://authoritywang.github.io/v3/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/AuthorityWang/VideoGS "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>efficiency &middot; multi-view &middot; explicit &middot; streaming &middot; compression &middot; real-time</sub> | <ol><li>Rearranges dynamic Gaussian attributes as multi-channel 2D video so standard hardware video codecs can stream them to mobile devices.</li><li>Uses hash-encoded motion, Gaussian pruning, and entropy-temporal refinement to disentangle motion and appearance while reducing storage.</li><li>Provides multi-platform players that decode and render streamed volumetric video on common devices.</li></ol> |
| [SwinGS: Sliding Window Gaussian Splatting for Volumetric Video Streaming with Arbitrary Length](https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.07759) (2024)<br><br><sub>efficiency &middot; streaming &middot; native-4dgs &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; real-time &middot; driving</sub> | <ol><li>Enables training, delivering, and rendering volumetric video in a real-time streaming fashion.</li><li>Reduces transmission costs by 83.6% compared to previous work and could be easily scaled to volumetric videos with arbitrary length with no increasing of required GPU resources.</li></ol> |
| [Compact 3D Gaussian Splatting for Static and Dynamic Radiance Fields](https://arxiv.org/abs/2408.03822) (2024)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://maincold2.github.io/c3dgs/ "Project page")<br><sub>efficiency &middot; compression &middot; real-time</sub> | <ol><li>Introduces a learnable mask strategy that reduces the number of Gaussians while preserving high performance.</li><li>Introduces a compact but effective representation of view-dependent color by employing a grid-based neural field rather than relying on spherical harmonics.</li><li>Learns codebooks to compactly represent the geometric and temporal attributes by residual vector quantization.</li></ol> |
| [Superpoint Gaussian Splatting for Real-Time High-Fidelity Dynamic Scene Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.03697) (2024)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://dnvtmf.github.io/SP_GS.github.io "Project page")<br><sub>efficiency &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; real-time &middot; robotics &middot; synthetic</sub> | <ol><li>Groups explicit 3D Gaussians with similar rotation, translation, and position into shared superpoints.</li><li>First employs explicit 3D Gaussians to reconstruct the scene and then clusters Gaussians with similar properties (e.g., rotation, translation, and location) into superpoints.</li></ol> |
| [3DGStream: On-the-Fly Training of 3D Gaussians for Efficient Streaming of Photo-Realistic Free-Viewpoint Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.01444) (2024)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://sjojok.top/3dgstream/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/SJoJoK/3DGStream "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>efficiency &middot; multi-view &middot; online &middot; streaming &middot; fast-training &middot; real-time</sub> | <ol><li>Uses a compact Neural Transformation Cache to predict per-frame Gaussian translations and rotations instead of independently optimizing every primitive.</li><li>Adds Gaussians adaptively for newly appearing content while carrying the transformed representation forward through the stream.</li><li>Approximately 12-second per-frame reconstruction and 200 FPS rendering for multi-view free-viewpoint video.</li></ol> |
| [Mesh-based Gaussian Splatting for Real-time Large-scale Deformation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.04796) (2024)<br><br><sub>efficiency &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; real-time &middot; generation &middot; driving &middot; human</sub> | <ol><li>Enables interactive deformation directly on Gaussian-splatting scenes.</li><li>Uses a large-scale Gaussian deformation technique to enable deformable GS, which alters the parameters of 3D Gaussians according to the manipulation of the associated mesh.</li><li>Achieves reconstruction and effective deformation, while maintaining the promising rendering results at a high frame rate(65 FPS on average).</li></ol> |
| [DynMF: Neural Motion Factorization for Real-time Dynamic View Synthesis with 3D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.00112) (2023)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://agelosk.github.io/dynmf/ "Project page")<br><sub>efficiency &middot; per-scene &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; fast-training &middot; real-time &middot; tracking</sub> | <ol><li>Factorizes Gaussian motion into a small set of global basis trajectories and per-Gaussian combination coefficients.</li><li>Uses sparsity to disentangle independently moving regions without requiring object-level supervision.</li><li>Provides efficient training and real-time rendering while exposing trajectories useful for point tracking.</li></ol> |
| [A Compact Dynamic 3D Gaussian Representation for Real-Time Dynamic View Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.12897) (2023)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://compactdynamic3dgaussian.github.io/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/raven38/EfficientDynamic3DGaussian "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>efficiency &middot; monocular &middot; multi-view &middot; per-scene &middot; compression &middot; real-time</sub> | <ol><li>Models Gaussian positions and rotations as compact functions of time while keeping scale, color, and opacity invariant.</li><li>Reduces representation memory and relaxes the dense multi-view observation requirement of per-timestep dynamic Gaussians.</li><li>Supports monocular and multi-view reconstruction while reporting 118 FPS at 1,352 by 1,014 resolution on a single GPU.</li></ol> |

## Feed-forward 4DGS

Methods that reconstruct, generate, encode, or compress a dynamic Gaussian representation in a
learned forward pass, rather than optimizing a new representation from scratch for every sequence.

| Paper (arXiv) | Key contributions |
| --- | --- |
| [GUSH3R: Everyone Everywhere All at Once as Gaussians](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05243) (2026)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://abkeito.github.io/gush3r-page/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/abkeito/GUSH3R "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>feed-forward &middot; monocular &middot; online &middot; human</sub> | <ol><li>Uses feed-forward for online dynamic human-scene reconstruction.</li><li>Reconstructs dynamic humans and static scenes as geometrically consistent 3DGS primitives in one feed-forward pass from monocular video.</li></ol> |
| [HiReFF: High-Resolution Feedforward Human Reconstruction from Uncalibrated Sparse-View Video](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29333) (2026)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://iridescentjiang.github.io/HiReFF "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/IridescentJiang/HiReFF "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>sparse-reconstruction &middot; multi-view &middot; sparse-view &middot; unposed &middot; feed-forward &middot; streaming</sub> | <ol><li>Uses feed-forward for 2K-resolution 360° human video reconstruction from uncalibrated sparse-view videos.</li><li>Decomposes the pipeline into foreground 3D Gaussian reconstruction from sparse-view videos (four views separated by 90°) and computationally efficient high-resolution synthesis.</li></ol> |
| [Hand-4DGS: Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting for 4D Hand Reconstruction from Egocentric Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19156) (2026)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://jeongminb.github.io/hand-4dgs/ "Project page")<br><sub>feed-forward &middot; monocular &middot; human &middot; mesh-anchored &middot; real-time</sub> | <ol><li>Introduces a feed-forward framework for reconstructing dynamic 4D hands directly from egocentric video.</li><li>Uses a mesh-guided representation and temporal convolutions to provide structural priors and model hand motion.</li><li>Uses Gaussian-splatting image supervision without requiring 3D hand-pose ground truth.</li></ol> |
| [Envision4D: Envisioning Visual Futures via Feed-forward 4D Gaussian Splatting for Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.10656) (2026)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://maggiesong7.github.io/research/Envision4D/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/maggiesong7/Envision4D "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>feed-forward &middot; self-supervised &middot; unposed &middot; driving &middot; continuous-time</sub> | <ol><li>Introduces a self-supervised feed-forward framework for pose-free future-view extrapolation in driving scenes.</li><li>Predicts future camera parameters through iterative denoising and models nonlinear dynamics with temporal attention and conditioned motion lifting.</li><li>Uses progressive training to stabilize unsupervised motion learning against error accumulation.</li></ol> |
| [Learning Global Motion with Compact Gaussians for Feed-Forward 4D Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31595) (2026)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://cvlab-kaist.github.io/C4G/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/cvlab-kaist/C4G "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>feed-forward &middot; monocular &middot; unposed &middot; tracking &middot; native-4dgs</sub> | <ol><li>Introduces timestamp-conditioned learnable Gaussian query tokens that aggregate full temporal context for feed-forward 4D reconstruction.</li><li>Decodes Gaussians whose positions are modulated by target time.</li><li>Extends feature aggregation to a 4D feature field for point tracking and dynamic scene understanding, with video-diffusion rendering enhancement.</li></ol> |
| [No Pose, No Problem in 4D: Feed-Forward Dynamic Gaussians from Unposed Multi-View Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.22190) (2026)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://bralani.github.io/nopo4d_html/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/bralani/NoPo4D "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>feed-forward &middot; multi-view &middot; unposed &middot; self-supervised &middot; native-4dgs</sub> | <ol><li>Introduces a feed-forward system for dynamic multi-view reconstruction with unknown camera poses.</li><li>Decomposes Gaussian motion into image-plane shifts and depth changes.</li><li>Adds bidirectional motion encoding and view-dependent opacity to aggregate features and mitigate Gaussian misalignment.</li></ol> |
| [Ground4D: Spatially-Grounded Feedforward 4D Reconstruction for Unstructured Off-Road Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.04435) (2026)<br><br>[![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/wsnbws/Ground4D "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>feed-forward &middot; unposed &middot; driving &middot; native-4dgs &middot; depth-prior</sub> | <ol><li>Introduces pose-free feed-forward 4D reconstruction specialized for unstructured off-road scenes.</li><li>Uses voxel-grounded temporal Gaussian aggregation with query-conditioned temporal attention to resolve cross-timestamp conflicts.</li><li>Regularizes Gaussian geometry with surface-normal cues.</li></ol> |
| [ReconDrive: Fast Feed-Forward 4D Gaussian Splatting for Autonomous Driving Scene Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.07552) (2026)<br><br>[![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/TuojingAI/ReconDrive "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>feed-forward &middot; driving &middot; large-model &middot; hybrid &middot; fast-training</sub> | <ol><li>Adapts the VGGT 3D foundation model to generate 4D Gaussian scene representations for driving scenes in a forward pass.</li><li>Uses hybrid Gaussian prediction heads that separate spatial-coordinate regression from appearance prediction.</li><li>Represents dynamic environments through static-dynamic composition with velocity modeling.</li></ol> |
| [UFO-4D: Unposed Feedforward 4D Reconstruction from Two Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.24290) (2026)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://ufo-4d.github.io/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/ufo-4d/ufo-4d "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>sparse-reconstruction &middot; feed-forward &middot; two-view &middot; unposed &middot; self-supervised &middot; explicit</sub> | <ol><li>Reconstructs a dense explicit 4D representation from two unposed images in a unified feed-forward framework.</li><li>Jointly estimates dynamic Gaussian geometry, 3D motion, and camera pose.</li><li>Renders multiple signals from shared Gaussians, coupling appearance, depth, and motion for self-supervised image-synthesis training.</li></ol> |
| [DGGT: Feedforward 4D Reconstruction of Dynamic Driving Scenes using Unposed Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.03004) (2025)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://xiaomi-research.github.io/dggt/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/xiaomi-research/dggt "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>sparse-reconstruction &middot; feed-forward &middot; unposed &middot; sparse-view &middot; driving &middot; native-4dgs</sub> | <ol><li>Reformulates camera pose as a model output for pose-free, single-pass driving-scene reconstruction from sparse images.</li><li>Jointly predicts per-frame Gaussian maps and camera parameters, with dynamic and lifespan heads for motion and temporal visibility.</li></ol> |
| [WorldSplat: Gaussian-Centric Feed-Forward 4D Scene Generation for Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.23402) (2025)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://wm-research.github.io/worldsplat/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/xiaomi-research/worldsplat "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>generation &middot; feed-forward &middot; driving &middot; native-4dgs &middot; multi-view</sub> | <ol><li>Introduces a feed-forward framework for generating 4D driving scenes with Gaussian-centric representations.</li><li>Uses a multimodal 4D-aware latent diffusion model to produce pixel-aligned 4D Gaussians.</li><li>Refines Gaussian-rendered novel-view videos with a video diffusion model for spatially and temporally consistent multi-track outputs.</li></ol> |
| [D-FCGS: Feedforward Compression of Dynamic Gaussian Splatting for Free-Viewpoint Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.05859) (2025)<br><br>[![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Mr-Zwkid/D-FCGS "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>efficiency &middot; multi-view &middot; feed-forward &middot; explicit &middot; compression &middot; streaming</sub> | <ol><li>Defines a standardized group-of-frames structure with I-P coding and sparse control points for extracting inter-frame motion tensors.</li><li>Combines hyperprior and spatiotemporal priors for entropy modeling with control-point-guided motion compensation and refinement.</li><li>Generalizes zero-shot across Gaussian sequences.</li></ol> |
| [4DGT: Learning a 4D Gaussian Transformer Using Real-World Monocular Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.08015) (2025)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://4dgt.github.io/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/facebookresearch/4DGT "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>feed-forward &middot; monocular &middot; native-4dgs &middot; large-model &middot; real-time</sub> | <ol><li>Trains a Transformer on real-world posed monocular videos to predict 4D Gaussians in feed-forward inference.</li><li>Unifies static and dynamic components while modeling varying object lifespans in time-varying scenes.</li><li>Introduces density control and rolling-window prediction for longer space-time inputs and efficient runtime rendering.</li></ol> |
| [Instant Gaussian Stream: Fast and Generalizable Streaming of Dynamic Scene Reconstruction via Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.16979) (2025)<br><br>[![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/yjb6/IGS "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>feed-forward &middot; multi-view &middot; online &middot; streaming &middot; fast-training</sub> | <ol><li>Introduces an anchor-driven motion network that lifts multi-view 2D motion features into 3D and predicts target-frame Gaussian motion in one inference.</li><li>Uses refined key frames to reconstruct complex motion and limit error accumulation during streaming.</li><li>Demonstrates in-domain and cross-domain generalization with average per-frame reconstruction slightly above two seconds.</li></ol> |
| [DrivingRecon: Large 4D Gaussian Reconstruction Model For Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.09043) (2024)<br><br>[![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/EnVision-Research/DriveRecon "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>feed-forward &middot; driving &middot; large-model &middot; native-4dgs &middot; editing</sub> | <ol><li>Introduces a generalizable model that directly predicts 4D Gaussians from surround-view driving videos.</li><li>Uses a prune-and-dilate block to reduce overlapping adjacent-view Gaussians and redundant background points.</li><li>Decouples dynamic and static content to learn geometry and motion features across time.</li></ol> |
| [Feed-Forward Bullet-Time Reconstruction of Dynamic Scenes from Monocular Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.03526) (2024)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://research.nvidia.com/labs/toronto-ai/bullet-timer/ "Project page")<br><sub>sparse-reconstruction &middot; feed-forward &middot; monocular &middot; native-4dgs &middot; real-time &middot; sparse-view</sub> | <ol><li>Introduces a motion-aware feed-forward model for bullet-time reconstruction and novel-view synthesis from casual monocular video.</li><li>Aggregates all context frames to reconstruct a 3D Gaussian scene at a selected target timestamp.</li><li>Uses a formulation intended to train across both static and dynamic scene datasets.</li></ol> |
| [L4GM: Large 4D Gaussian Reconstruction Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.10324) (2024)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://research.nvidia.com/labs/toronto-ai/l4gm/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/nv-tlabs/L4GM-official "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>feed-forward &middot; monocular &middot; large-model &middot; native-4dgs &middot; generation</sub> | <ol><li>Introduces a large reconstruction model that produces animated objects from single-view video in one feed-forward pass.</li><li>Builds a curated multiview animated-object training dataset derived from Objaverse assets.</li><li>Extends LGM with temporal self-attention and an interpolation model to produce temporally smoother per-frame Gaussian representations.</li></ol> |

## Dynamic tracking, segmentation, and SLAM

This section covers persistent point tracking, motion scaffolds, 4D scene understanding, and
dynamics-aware mapping. Some reconstruction papers are repeated because tracking is a primary
output of the method.

| Paper (arXiv) | Key contributions |
| --- | --- |
| [Track2Map: Online Deformable SLAM with Motion-Aware Pose Optimization in Robotic Surgery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.08408) (2026)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://track2map.github.io/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/styufo/Track2Map "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>tracking-slam &middot; slam &middot; online &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; tracking &middot; robotics</sub> | <ol><li>Track2Map jointly optimizes camera trajectory and 3D deformable scene representation directly from surgical video.</li><li>Introduces a track-anchored deformation initialization using dense 2D point tracks.</li><li>Improved reconstruction quality and camera trajectory against competing SLAM methods, as well as compared to non-SLAM methods that utilize camera trajectory priors.</li></ol> |
| [DeGenseGS: Geometrically and Semantically Decoupled Surgical Scene Understanding in 4D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04761) (2026)<br><br>[![Non-functional or unverified GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-8c959f?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/yimowwwww/DeGenseGS "Placeholder or documentation-only GitHub repository")<br><sub>tracking-slam &middot; per-scene &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; segmentation</sub> | <ol><li>Uses shared HexPlane kinematic latents to synchronize semantic evolution with scene dynamics while decoupling semantics from geometric deformation.</li><li>Optimizes semantic features in their hyperspherical latent space to preserve semantic-anatomic alignment under tissue deformation and topology changes.</li></ol> |
| [PhysMani: Physics-principled 3D World Model for Dynamic Object Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.01938) (2026)<br><br>[![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/vLAR-group/PhysMani "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>tracking-slam &middot; tracking &middot; online &middot; robotics &middot; physics-aware</sub> | <ol><li>Couples a physics-principled 3D Gaussian world model with a future-aware action policy model.</li><li>The policy model integrates the predicted 3D scene future dynamics through a learnable token based cross-attention module.</li><li>The world model learns a divergence-free Gaussian velocity field via online optimization for fast and physically grounded future dynamics prediction.</li></ol> |
| [DLGStream: Dynamic Language-embedded Guassian Splatting for Open-vocabulary Enabled Free-viewpoint Video Streaming](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.28840) (2026)<br><br>[![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/kkkzh/DLGStream "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>tracking-slam &middot; multi-view &middot; segmentation &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; streaming &middot; editing</sub> | <ol><li>Introduces DLGStream, a language-embedded FVV representation that streams time-varying language features alongside Gaussian attributes to support 4D environment interaction, scene editing, and spatial intelligence.</li><li>Maintains two opacity attributes for color and language features to deal with performance degradation that occurs when colors and features are jointly optimized.</li><li>DLGStream achieves performance in both on open-vocabulary segmentation and reconstruction quality with an average frame size of merely 43 KB.</li></ol> |
