| [DynMF: Neural Motion Factorization for Real-time Dynamic View Synthesis with 3D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.00112) (2023)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://agelosk.github.io/dynmf/ "Project page")<br><sub>efficiency &middot; per-scene &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; fast-training &middot; real-time &middot; tracking</sub> | <ol><li>Factorizes Gaussian motion into a small set of global basis trajectories and per-Gaussian combination coefficients.</li><li>Uses sparsity to disentangle independently moving regions without requiring object-level supervision.</li><li>Provides efficient training and real-time rendering while exposing trajectories useful for point tracking.</li></ol> |
| [Dynamic 3D Gaussians: Tracking by Persistent Dynamic View Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2308.09713) (2023)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://dynamic3dgaussians.github.io/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/JonathonLuiten/Dynamic3DGaussians "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>tracking-slam &middot; multi-view &middot; per-scene &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; tracking &middot; editing</sub> | <ol><li>Jointly performs dynamic novel-view synthesis and dense 6-DoF tracking of scene elements.</li><li>Allows Gaussians to move and rotate while enforcing persistent color, opacity, and size over time.</li><li>Regularizes motion and rotation with local-rigidity constraints.</li></ol> |

## Dynamic humans and avatars

This section includes dynamic-human reconstruction and animatable Gaussian avatars. These works
may use articulated or mesh-anchored 3D Gaussians instead of a native 4D Gaussian primitive, but
they represent appearance over time and are part of the wider 4DGS ecosystem.

| Paper (arXiv) | Key contributions |
| --- | --- |
| [FA-LAM: Focus-Aware Large Avatar Model for One-Shot 4D Animatable Gaussian Head](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.20922) (2026)<br><br><sub>avatar &middot; multi-view &middot; human &middot; feed-forward &middot; streaming &middot; segmentation</sub> | <ol><li>Introduces FA-LAM, a Focus-Aware Large Avatar Model for one-shot animatable Gaussian head creation, while enabling static 3D and dynamic 4D full-head recovery.</li><li>Identifies two main factors that compromise the quality of 3D full-head generation: (1) incorrect and noisy attention activations, and (2) conflicts between the tasks of reconstruction and animation.</li></ol> |
| [FlexiAvatar: Unified 3D Gaussian Human Avatars Under Arbitrary Body Visibility](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.19100) (2026)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://yihalem1.github.io/FlexiAvatar/ "Project page")<br><sub>avatar &middot; monocular &middot; human &middot; tracking &middot; generation</sub> | <ol><li>FlexiAvatar explicitly optimizes only the visible body regions, effectively eliminating artifacts arising from unobserved limbs.</li><li>Integrates occlusion-robust SMPL-X tracking with part-specific residual refinement to capture high-frequency geometric and appearance details.</li><li>Experiments on full-body (NeuMan, ZJU-MoCap, WildAvatar), talk-show half-body, and INSTA head inputs report consistently higher reconstruction quality, with roughly 3% average PSNR improvement over prior methods.</li></ol> |
| [GaussianEmoTalker: Real-Time Emotional Talking Head Synthesis with Audio-Driven and Blendshape-Based 3D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.00959) (2026)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://njust-yang.github.io/GaussianEmoTalker.github.io/ "Project page")<br><sub>avatar &middot; human &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; real-time &middot; generation &middot; driving</sub> | <ol><li>Uses audio-driven for real-time emotional talking head synthesis based on 3D Gaussian Splatting.</li><li>Introduces a spatial-audio-emotion attention module that estimates the offsets of Gaussian attributes for expressive and temporally stable rendering.</li></ol> |
| [FFAvatar: Feed-Forward 4D Head Avatar Reconstruction from Sparse Portrait Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30347) (2026)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://jj-yao.github.io/ffavatar/ "Project page")<br><sub>avatar &middot; human &middot; feed-forward &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; driving &middot; large-model</sub> | <ol><li>Uses Transformer-based 3D Gaussian for fast construction of and animatable 4D head avatars from one or more reference portrait images.</li><li>An alternating attention mechanism disentangles identity appearance from expression and viewpoint variations.</li><li>FFAvatar efficiently produces and controllable 4D head avatars, achieving flexibility, driving efficiency, and identity-consistent rendering across diverse expressions and viewpoints.</li></ol> |
| [RAGA: Real Time Ray Traced Gaussian Shadow Casting for 3DGS Avatar-Scene Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29329) (2026)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://miraymen.github.io/raga/ "Project page")<br><sub>avatar &middot; human &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; real-time &middot; physics-aware</sub> | <ol><li>Introduces RAGA, a Ray-Traced Gaussian Shadow Casting formulation based on exact ray-Gaussian line integrals.</li><li>Performs shadow computation entirely in Gaussian space, without requiring any mesh reconstruction.</li></ol> |
| [FiCA: Feed-forward instant Gaussian Codec Avatars from a Single Portrait Image](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.24232) (2026)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://kim-youwang.github.io/FiCA "Project page")<br><sub>avatar &middot; human &middot; feed-forward &middot; real-time &middot; compression &middot; generation</sub> | <ol><li>Introduces FiCA, a Feed-forward, instant Gaussian Codec Avatar generation pipeline that creates lifelike avatars from a single portrait image.</li><li>Introduces a feed-forward mesh refinement network that enhances the fidelity and identity preservation of the generated avatars, eliminating the need for person-specific test-time optimization.</li><li>Generating a photorealistic and drivable avatar from just a single image is challenging due to the limited visual information available to accurately infer the 3D appearance and geometry of human heads.</li></ol> |
| [SpatialAvatar-0: High-Quality 4D Head Avatar with Multi-Stage Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15659) (2026)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://spatialwalk.github.io/SpatialAvatar-0 "Project page")<br><sub>avatar &middot; monocular &middot; multi-view &middot; human &middot; feed-forward &middot; generation</sub> | <ol><li>Combines a feed-forward generator, K-source mean pooling, and monocular-to-multiview training on FLAME-bound Gaussians.</li><li>Introduces a 10K-iter layout-preserving per-subject refinement loop that freezes the FLAME-binding and Gaussian count and replaces densification with a three-component anti-spike regularization.</li></ol> |
| [Self-Learning Expression Deformations for Data-Efficient Gaussian Avatars](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05912) (2026)<br><br><sub>avatar &middot; monocular &middot; multi-view &middot; human &middot; feed-forward &middot; self-supervised</sub> | <ol><li>Enables self-learning expression-induced Gaussian deformations that enables high-fidelity, animatable avatars from minimal input data.</li><li>Jointly optimizes 2D Gaussian surfels and an SDF, then self-supervises expression deformation with geometric and appearance consistency.</li></ol> |
| [AvatarPointillist: AutoRegressive 4D Gaussian Avatarization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.04787) (2026)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://kumapowerliu.github.io/AvatarPointillist/ "Project page")<br><sub>generation &middot; monocular &middot; feed-forward &middot; human &middot; native-4dgs</sub> | <ol><li>Generates a dynamic Gaussian avatar from a single portrait with a decoder-only autoregressive Transformer that emits an adaptive point cloud.</li><li>Jointly predicts per-point binding information for animation, then decodes complete Gaussian attributes from the generated points.</li><li>Conditions the Gaussian decoder on autoregressive latent features to improve avatar fidelity.</li></ol> |
| [HOIGS: Human-Object Interaction Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.04016) (2026)<br><br><sub>avatar &middot; human &middot; per-scene &middot; deformable-3dgs</sub> | <ol><li>Models human and object motion with separate representations suited to articulated bodies and rigid-object trajectories.</li><li>Combines HexPlane human features with cubic Hermite spline object features through interaction-aware cross-attention.</li></ol> |
| [AHOY! Animatable Humans under Occlusion from YouTube Videos with Gaussian Splatting and Video Diffusion Priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.17975) (2026)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://miraymen.github.io/ahoy/ "Project page")<br><sub>avatar &middot; monocular &middot; multi-view &middot; human &middot; generation</sub> | <ol><li>Enables reconstructing complete, animatable 3D Gaussian avatars from in-the-wild monocular video despite heavy occlusion.</li><li>Uses identity-finetuned diffusion to supervise occluded body regions and a two-stage canonical-to-pose architecture for sparse observations.</li><li>Reconstructing from such footage poses fundamental challenges: large body regions may never be observed, and multi-view supervision per pose is unavailable.</li></ol> |
| [ProgressiveAvatars: Progressive Animatable 3D Gaussian Avatars](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.16447) (2026)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://ustc3dv.github.io/ProgressiveAvatars/ "Project page")<br><sub>avatar &middot; human &middot; real-time &middot; streaming</sub> | <ol><li>Introduces ProgressiveAvatars, a progressive avatar representation built on a hierarchy of 3D Gaussians grown by adaptive implicit subdivision on a template mesh. 3D Gaussians are defined in face-local coordinates.</li><li>The hierarchy expands when screen-space signals indicate a lack of detail, allocating resources to important areas.</li><li>Leveraging importance ranking, ProgressiveAvatars supports incremental loading and rendering, adding new Gaussians as they arrive while preserving previous content, thus achieving smooth quality improvements across varying bandwidths.</li></ol> |
| [Uncertainty-Aware 4D Gaussian Splatting for Monocular Occluded Human Rendering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.06343) (2026)<br><br><sub>avatar &middot; monocular &middot; human &middot; native-4dgs &middot; uncertainty &middot; per-scene</sub> | <ol><li>Formulates occluded monocular human rendering as maximum a posteriori estimation under heteroscedastic observation noise.</li><li>Combines a probabilistic deformation network with joint rasterization to render uncertainty maps that modulate unreliable image gradients.</li><li>Uses confidence-aware regularization to prevent geometric drift where visual evidence is unreliable.</li></ol> |
| [VRGaussianAvatar: Integrating 3D Gaussian Avatars into VR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.01674) (2026)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://vrgaussianavatar.github.io "Project page")<br><sub>avatar &middot; human &middot; real-time &middot; streaming &middot; tracking</sub> | <ol><li>VRGaussianAvatar enables real-time full-body 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) avatars in virtual reality using only head-mounted display (HMD) tracking signals.</li><li>Jointly processes left and right eye views in a single batched pass to reduce redundant computation and support high-resolution VR displays.</li><li>VRGaussianAvatar sustains interactive VR performance and yields higher perceived appearance similarity, embodiment, and plausibility.</li></ol> |
| [Animated 3DGS Avatars in Diverse Scenes with Consistent Lighting and Shadows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.01660) (2026)<br><br><sub>avatar &middot; human &middot; real-time &middot; relighting</sub> | <ol><li>Targets consistent lighting and shadows when animated 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) avatars interact with 3DGS scenes or with dynamic objects inserted into otherwise static scenes.</li><li>Demonstrates environment consistent lighting for avatars from AvatarX and ActorsHQ, composited into ScanNet++, DL3DV, and SuperSplat scenes, and show interactions with inserted objects.</li><li>The key contribution is Deep Gaussian Shadow Maps (DGSM), a modern analogue of the classical shadow mapping algorithm tailored to the volumetric 3DGS representation.</li></ol> |
| [Interaction-Aware 4D Gaussian Splatting for Dynamic Hand-Object Interaction Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.14540) (2025)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://haotian23ucas.github.io/Interaction-Aware-Gau/ "Project page")<br><sub>avatar &middot; human &middot; per-scene &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; tracking</sub> | <ol><li>Introduces a structured Gaussian representation specialized for jointly reconstructing deforming hands and manipulated objects.</li><li>Conditions object deformation on hand motion to capture interaction rather than optimizing the two actors independently.</li><li>Uses progressive static-to-dynamic optimization with physical and illumination regularization for stable reconstruction.</li></ol> |
| [AHA! Animating Human Avatars in Diverse Scenes with Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.09827) (2025)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://miraymen.github.io/aha/ "Project page")<br><sub>avatar &middot; monocular &middot; multi-view &middot; human &middot; editing &middot; generation</sub> | <ol><li>Targets animating humans in 3D scenes using 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), a neural scene representation that has recently achieved photorealistic results for novel-view synthesis but remains under-explored for human-scene animation.</li><li>A Gaussian-aligned motion module synthesizes motion without explicit scene geometry, using opacity-based cues and projected Gaussian structures to guide human placement and pose alignment.</li><li>Introduces the use of 3DGS as the 3D representation for animating humans in scenes.</li></ol> |
| [HGC-Avatar: Hierarchical Gaussian Compression for Streamable Dynamic 3D Avatars](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.16463) (2025)<br><br><sub>avatar &middot; human &middot; compression &middot; streaming &middot; generation</sub> | <ol><li>Introduces HGC-Avatar, a Hierarchical Gaussian Compression framework designed for efficient transmission and rendering of dynamic avatars.</li><li>Disentangles the Gaussian representation into a structural layer, which maps poses to Gaussians via a StyleUNet-based generator, and a motion layer, which leverages the SMPL-X model to represent temporal pose variations compactly.</li></ol> |
| [FMGS-Avatar: Mesh-Guided 2D Gaussian Splatting with Foundation Model Priors for 3D Monocular Avatar Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.14739) (2025)<br><br><sub>avatar &middot; monocular &middot; human &middot; segmentation</sub> | <ol><li>Integrates two key innovations.</li><li>Introduces Mesh-Guided 2D Gaussian Splatting, where 2D Gaussian primitives are attached directly to template mesh faces with constrained position, rotation, and movement.</li></ol> |
| [StreamME: Simplify 3D Gaussian Avatar within Live Stream](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.17029) (2025)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://songluchuan.github.io/StreamME/ "Project page")<br><sub>avatar &middot; human &middot; online &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; streaming &middot; generation</sub> | <ol><li>StreamME targets fast 3D avatar reconstruction.</li><li>StreamME synchronously records and reconstructs a head avatar from live video streams without any pre-cached data.</li></ol> |
| [HyperGaussians: High-Dimensional Gaussian Splatting for High-Fidelity Animatable Face Avatars](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.02803) (2025)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://gserifi.github.io/HyperGaussians "Project page")<br><sub>avatar &middot; monocular &middot; human &middot; deformable-3dgs</sub> | <ol><li>Introduces HyperGaussians, a extension of 3D Gaussian Splatting for animatable face avatars.</li><li>Creating such detailed face avatars from videos is a challenging problem and has numerous applications in augmented and virtual reality.</li></ol> |
| [SkinningGS: Editable Dynamic Human Scene Reconstruction Using Gaussian Splatting Based on a Skinning Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.21632) (2025)<br><br><sub>avatar &middot; monocular &middot; human &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; real-time &middot; editing</sub> | <ol><li>Introduces a position texture to subdivide the Skinned Multi-Person Linear (SMPL) body model's surface and grow the human point cloud.</li><li>Adopts a strategy of point cloud decoupling and joint optimization to achieve the decoupled reconstruction of backgrounds and human bodies while preserving the interactivity of human motion.</li><li>Uses a convolutional neural network structure to predict human body point cloud features based on texture.</li></ol> |
| [GSAC: Leveraging Gaussian Splatting for Photorealistic Avatar Creation with Unity Integration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.12999) (2025)<br><br>[![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/VU-RASL/GSAC "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>avatar &middot; monocular &middot; human &middot; real-time &middot; editing &middot; physics-aware</sub> | <ol><li>Introduces an end-to-end 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) avatar creation pipeline that leverages monocular video input to create a scalable and efficient photorealistic avatar directly compatible.</li><li>Adds preprocessing for in-the-wild monocular video, facial-expression reconstruction, and integration with a fully rigged avatar.</li></ol> |
| [TaoAvatar: Real-Time Lifelike Full-Body Talking Avatars for Augmented Reality via 3D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.17032) (2025)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://pixelai-team.github.io/TaoAvatar "Project page")<br><sub>avatar &middot; human &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; real-time &middot; streaming &middot; editing</sub> | <ol><li>Introduces TaoAvatar, a lightweight full-body Gaussian talking avatar driven by facial, audio, and body-control signals.</li><li>Distills pose-dependent non-rigid deformations from a larger StyleUNet into a compact MLP and compensating blend shapes.</li><li>Supports real-time rendering on mobile and stereoscopic devices.</li></ol> |
| [GaussianAvatar-Editor: Photorealistic Animatable Gaussian Head Avatar Editor](https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.09978) (2025)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://xiangyueliu.github.io/GaussianAvatar-Editor/ "Project page")<br><sub>avatar &middot; human &middot; native-4dgs &middot; editing &middot; generation &middot; driving</sub> | <ol><li>GaussianAvatar-Editor enables text-driven editing of animatable Gaussian head avatars that can be fully controlled in expression, pose, and viewpoint.</li><li>Introduces the Weighted Alpha Blending Equation (WABE).</li></ol> |
| [GASP: Gaussian Avatars with Synthetic Priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.07739) (2024)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://microsoft.github.io/GASP/ "Project page")<br><sub>avatar &middot; monocular &middot; human &middot; feed-forward &middot; real-time &middot; generation</sub> | <ol><li>Trains a Gaussian-avatar prior on synthetic data, then fits and fine-tunes it to a single photo or video.</li><li>Produces animatable avatars with 360-degree rendering from limited monocular capture.</li><li>Uses the prior only during fitting.</li></ol> |
| [Sequential Gaussian Avatars with Hierarchical Motion Context](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.16768) (2024)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://zezeaaa.github.io/projects/SeqAvatar/ "Project page")<br><sub>avatar &middot; human &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; real-time &middot; driving</sub> | <ol><li>Models avatar deformation with hierarchical motion context over skeleton and vertex motion.</li><li>Combines coarse skeleton motion with fine-grained vertex motion for non-rigid deformation.</li><li>Renders avatars orders of magnitude faster than temporal NeRF baselines.</li></ol> |
| [Generalizable and Animatable Gaussian Head Avatar](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.07971) (2024)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://xg-chu.site/project_gagavatar/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/xg-chu/GAGAvatar "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>avatar &middot; monocular &middot; feed-forward &middot; human &middot; mesh-anchored &middot; real-time</sub> | <ol><li>Reconstructs an animatable head avatar from one image by predicting 3D Gaussian parameters in one forward pass.</li><li>Introduces dual lifting to create identity- and facial-detail-preserving Gaussians from image and 3D morphable-model features.</li><li>Supports unseen identities without per-subject optimization and real-time expression reenactment.</li></ol> |
| [Robust Dual Gaussian Splatting for Immersive Human-centric Volumetric Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.08353) (2024)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://nowheretrix.github.io/DualGS/ "Project page")<br><sub>avatar &middot; human &middot; real-time &middot; compression &middot; tracking &middot; generation</sub> | <ol><li>Introduces a Gaussian-based approach, dubbed DualGS, for real-time and playback of complex human performance with excellent compression ratios.</li><li>Employs a coarse-to-fine training strategy for frame-by-frame human performance modeling.</li><li>Achieves a compression ratio of up to 120 times, only requiring approximately 350KB of storage per frame.</li></ol> |
| [Expressive Whole-Body 3D Gaussian Avatar](https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.21686) (2024)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://mks0601.github.io/ExAvatar/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/mks0601/ExAvatar_RELEASE "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>avatar &middot; monocular &middot; human &middot; hybrid &middot; mesh-anchored &middot; per-scene</sub> | <ol><li>Builds a whole-body avatar from a short monocular video by combining SMPL-X mesh topology with 3D Gaussians.</li><li>Associates Gaussians with mesh connectivity so SMPL-X expression parameters drive facial expressions.</li><li>Uses connectivity-based regularizers to reduce artifacts under expressions and poses.</li></ol> |
| [GoMAvatar: Efficient Animatable Human Modeling from Monocular Video Using Gaussians-on-Mesh](https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.07991) (2024)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://wenj.github.io/GoMAvatar/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/wenj/GoMAvatar "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>avatar &middot; monocular &middot; human &middot; hybrid &middot; mesh-anchored &middot; real-time</sub> | <ol><li>Introduces a Gaussians-on-Mesh representation that combines splatting with deformable mesh geometry for animatable humans from monocular video.</li><li>Supports novel-pose animation and novel-view rasterization-compatible rendering.</li><li>Targets memory-efficient real-time avatars through a compact hybrid representation.</li></ol> |
| [HAHA: Highly Articulated Gaussian Human Avatars with Textured Mesh Prior](https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.01053) (2024)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://david-svitov.github.io/HAHA_project_page/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/david-svitov/HAHA "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>avatar &middot; monocular &middot; human &middot; hybrid &middot; mesh-anchored</sub> | <ol><li>Combines a textured SMPL-X mesh with Gaussians placed only where mesh rendering is insufficient, such as hair and out-of-mesh clothing.</li><li>Uses the hybrid representation to animate highly articulated full-body avatars, including fingers, from monocular video.</li><li>Reduces Gaussian count while retaining novel-pose rendering.</li></ol> |
| [SplattingAvatar: Realistic Real-Time Human Avatars with Mesh-Embedded Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.05087) (2024)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://initialneil.github.io/SplattingAvatar "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/initialneil/SplattingAvatar/tree/neil-dev "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>avatar &middot; monocular &middot; human &middot; hybrid &middot; mesh-anchored &middot; real-time</sub> | <ol><li>Embeds Gaussian splats on a triangle mesh using barycentric coordinates and displacement to create a hybrid human representation.</li><li>Uses mesh-controlled Gaussian transformations instead of an MLP skinning field, supporting skeletal animation, blend shapes, and mesh editing.</li><li>Disentangles low-frequency mesh motion from high-frequency Gaussian geometry and appearance.</li></ol> |
| [GaussianBody: Clothed Human Reconstruction via 3d Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.09720) (2024)<br><br><sub>avatar &middot; human &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; physics-aware</sub> | <ol><li>GaussianBody uses 3D Gaussian Splatting for clothed human reconstruction.</li><li>Uses pose-guided deformation and transformation regularization to associate Gaussians between canonical and observation spaces.</li></ol> |
| [Deformable 3D Gaussian Splatting for Animatable Human Avatars](https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.15059) (2023)<br><br><sub>avatar &middot; monocular &middot; human &middot; per-scene &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; explicit</sub> | <ol><li>Introduces ParDy-Human, a fully explicit avatar representation that can be learned from as little as one monocular sequence without human masks or other auxiliary annotations.</li><li>Deforms canonical Gaussians first from SMPL vertices, then predicts joint-conditioned per-Gaussian refinements for motion beyond the body model.</li><li>Supports variable training backgrounds and efficient full-resolution inference on consumer hardware.</li></ol> |
| [3DGS-Avatar: Animatable Avatars via Deformable 3D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.09228) (2023)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://neuralbodies.github.io/3DGS-Avatar "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/mikeqzy/3dgs-avatar-release "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>avatar &middot; human &middot; monocular &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; real-time</sub> | <ol><li>Reconstructs animatable clothed-human avatars from monocular video using deformable 3D Gaussian primitives.</li><li>Regularizes non-rigid deformation with an as-isometric-as-possible constraint to preserve local surface structure.</li><li>Provides fast subject-specific training and real-time novel-pose rendering.</li></ol> |
| [ASH: Animatable Gaussian Splats for Efficient and Photoreal Human Rendering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.05941) (2023)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://vcai.mpi-inf.mpg.de/projects/ash/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/kv2000/ASH "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>avatar &middot; multi-view &middot; human &middot; per-scene &middot; mesh-anchored &middot; real-time</sub> | <ol><li>Attaches animatable Gaussians to a deformable character model for controllable, photorealistic rendering of clothed humans.</li><li>Learns Gaussian geometry and appearance in 2D texture space with convolutional networks instead of optimizing every parameter directly in 3D.</li><li>Supports real-time novel-view rendering and skeletal motion retargeting while retaining pose-dependent clothing detail.</li></ol> |
| [HiFi4G: High-Fidelity Human Performance Rendering via Compact Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.03461) (2023)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://nowheretrix.github.io/HiFi4G/ "Project page")<br><sub>avatar &middot; multi-view &middot; human &middot; compression &middot; tracking &middot; native-4dgs</sub> | <ol><li>Combines Gaussian splatting with non-rigid tracking through a coarse deformation graph and fine Gaussian graph.</li><li>Optimizes a 4D Gaussian representation with adaptive spatial-temporal regularization for dense human-performance footage.</li><li>Introduces residual-compensated compression for compact playback-oriented representations.</li></ol> |
| [GauHuman: Articulated Gaussian Splatting from Monocular Human Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.02973) (2023)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://skhu101.github.io/GauHuman/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/skhu101/GauHuman "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>avatar &middot; human &middot; monocular &middot; mesh-anchored &middot; fast-training &middot; real-time</sub> | <ol><li>Transforms canonical Gaussians into posed space with linear blend skinning while jointly refining pose and skinning weights.</li><li>Uses human-prior initialization and structure-aware split, clone, merge, and pruning operations for efficient optimization.</li><li>Achieves minute-scale training and high-frame-rate free-viewpoint rendering from a monocular video.</li></ol> |
| [HeadGaS: Real-Time Animatable Head Avatars via 3D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.02902) (2023)<br><br><sub>avatar &middot; monocular &middot; human &middot; per-scene &middot; hybrid &middot; real-time</sub> | <ol><li>Builds an animatable head avatar by augmenting explicit 3D Gaussian splats with a learned latent feature basis.</li><li>Linearly blends the latent basis with low-dimensional parametric-head controls to produce expression-dependent Gaussian color and opacity.</li><li>Achieves real-time inference while reporting more than a tenfold rendering-speed improvement over prior baselines.</li></ol> |
| [GaussianAvatar: Towards Realistic Human Avatar Modeling from a Single Video via Animatable 3D Gaussians](https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.02134) (2023)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://huliangxiao.github.io/GaussianAvatar "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/aipixel/GaussianAvatar "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>avatar &middot; monocular &middot; human &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; per-scene &middot; explicit</sub> | <ol><li>Introduces animatable explicit 3D Gaussians for human appearance across poses and clothing styles from a single video.</li><li>Models pose-dependent appearance using a dynamic appearance network and optimizable feature tensor.</li><li>Jointly optimizes motion and appearance through differentiable motion conditioning to address inaccurate monocular motion estimates.</li></ol> |
| [GaussianAvatars: Photorealistic Head Avatars with Rigged 3D Gaussians](https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.02069) (2023)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://shenhanqian.github.io/gaussian-avatars "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/ShenhanQian/GaussianAvatars "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>avatar &middot; multi-view &middot; human &middot; mesh-anchored &middot; explicit &middot; real-time</sub> | <ol><li>Rigs dynamic 3D Gaussian splats to a parametric morphable face model for controllable pose and expression animation.</li><li>Parameterizes splats in triangle-local coordinate frames with learned displacement offsets.</li><li>Jointly optimizes facial-model and Gaussian parameters for end-to-end avatar reconstruction and reenactment.</li></ol> |
| [HUGS: Human Gaussian Splats](https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.17910) (2023)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://machinelearning.apple.com/research/hugs "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/apple/ml-hugs "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>avatar &middot; monocular &middot; human &middot; mesh-anchored &middot; fast-training &middot; real-time</sub> | <ol><li>Learns a static scene and fully animatable human avatar from a short monocular video using 3D Gaussian splatting.</li><li>Initializes human Gaussians with SMPL and permits deviations for clothing and hair details.</li><li>Jointly optimizes skinning weights to coordinate Gaussian articulation for novel-pose synthesis.</li></ol> |
| [Human Gaussian Splatting: Real-time Rendering of Animatable Avatars](https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.17113) (2023)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://perezpellitero.github.io/projects/hugs/ "Project page")<br><sub>avatar &middot; multi-view &middot; human &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; real-time &middot; per-scene</sub> | <ol><li>Represents the human body with canonical-space Gaussians learned end-to-end from multi-view observations.</li><li>Deforms the representation with coarse forward skinning followed by local non-rigid refinement.</li><li>Targets real-time novel-pose rendering of clothed-body avatars.</li></ol> |
| [GART: Gaussian Articulated Template Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.16099) (2023)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://jiahuilei.com/projects/gart/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/JiahuiLei/GART "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>avatar &middot; monocular &middot; human &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; fast-training &middot; real-time</sub> | <ol><li>Uses a mixture of moving 3D Gaussians to explicitly model articulated, non-rigid subjects from monocular video.</li><li>Combines a category template such as SMPL or SMAL with learnable forward skinning and latent bones for complex deformation.</li><li>Enables reconstruction in seconds or minutes and fast novel-pose rendering.</li></ol> |
| [Animatable and Relightable Gaussians for High-fidelity Human Avatar Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.16096) (2023)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://animatable-gaussians.github.io/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/lizhe00/AnimatableGaussians "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>avatar &middot; multi-view &middot; human &middot; mesh-anchored &middot; relighting &middot; deformable-3dgs</sub> | <ol><li>Parameterizes an animatable template with front and back canonical Gaussian maps.</li><li>Uses an adaptive garment-aware template and pose projection for novel-pose generalization.</li><li>Introduces physically based rendering to decompose material properties and environment illumination for relighting.</li></ol> |
| [SplatArmor: Articulated Gaussian splatting for animatable humans from monocular RGB videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.10812) (2023)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://jenaroh.it/splatarmor/ "Project page")<br><sub>avatar &middot; monocular &middot; human &middot; per-scene &middot; mesh-anchored &middot; deformable-3dgs</sub> | <ol><li>Represents a human with canonical 3D Gaussians whose articulation extends SMPL forward skinning to arbitrary canonical-space locations.</li><li>Introduces a pose-dependent SE(3) field that controls both Gaussian positions and anisotropy.</li><li>Uses a neural color field for color regularization and 3D supervision of Gaussian placement.</li></ol> |
| [Drivable 3D Gaussian Avatars](https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.08581) (2023)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://wojciechzielonka.com/d3ga/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/facebookresearch/D3GA "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>avatar &middot; multi-view &middot; human &middot; mesh-anchored &middot; explicit &middot; tracking</sub> | <ol><li>Embeds 3D Gaussian primitives in tetrahedral cages, using deformation gradients to transform their orientation and kernels.</li><li>Decouples low-dimensional driving signals from Gaussian primitives through localized cage deformation and learned vertex offsets.</li><li>Composes independently driven avatar layers, such as garments, hands, and face.</li></ol> |

## Adjacent and supporting dynamic-view work

Non-Gaussian dynamic-view methods, static-map dynamic SLAM systems, datasets, surveys, and other
context useful for evaluating or understanding 4DGS. These records are deliberately separated
from methods whose central representation is a time-varying Gaussian field.

| Paper (arXiv) | Key contributions |
| --- | --- |
| [DL-SLAM: Enabling High-Fidelity Gaussian Splatting SLAM in Dynamic Environments based on Dual-Level Probability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.01860) (2026)<br><br><sub>tracking-slam &middot; monocular &middot; slam &middot; tracking &middot; segmentation &middot; generation</sub> | <ol><li>Adjacent work — Dynamic objects are detected and pruned to produce a static Gaussian map; their motion is not represented.</li><li>Introduces DL-SLAM, a monocular Gaussian Splatting SLAM system built upon a dual-level probabilistic framework.</li><li>Computes dynamic probability maps by combining semantic and geometric information.</li></ol> |
| [Flex4DHuman: Flexible Multi-view Video Diffusion for 4D Human Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.13655) (2026)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://andy-cheng.github.io/Flex4DHuman/ "Project page") [![Non-functional or unverified GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-8c959f?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Andy-Cheng/Flex4DHuman "Placeholder or documentation-only GitHub repository")<br><sub>sparse-reconstruction &middot; monocular &middot; sparse-view &middot; feed-forward &middot; human &middot; generation</sub> | <ol><li>Adjacent work — The main method is multi-view video diffusion; 4D Gaussian reconstruction is an off-the-shelf downstream stage.</li><li>Generates synchronized dense multi-view videos from monocular or sparse-view dynamic-subject footage using relative camera-pose conditioning.</li><li>Uses a five-axis positional encoding and staged curriculum for pose following, view generation, and temporal rollout before downstream 4DGS reconstruction.</li></ol> |
| [AvatarMix: Identity-Preserving Cross-Avatar Composition for Outfit Personalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03506) (2026)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://larsph.github.io/avatarmix/ "Project page")<br><sub>avatar &middot; multi-view &middot; human &middot; editing</sub> | <ol><li>Adjacent work — Composes and edits static appearance and geometry of Gaussian avatars without temporal or animation-specific processing.</li><li>Introduces AvatarMix, a compositional paradigm that bypasses these issues by directly composing the head and body from two Gaussian avatars.</li><li>Introduces a two-tier refinement strategy: SeamFix, a localized diffusion module that refines hair and neck to ensure an artifact-free join, and an optional full-body refinement, FullbodyFix, that restores garment appearance.</li></ol> |
| [GS-Surrogate: Deformable Gaussian Splatting for Parameter Space Exploration of Ensemble Simulations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.06358) (2026)<br><br><sub>generation &middot; editing &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; real-time &middot; driving</sub> | <ol><li>Adjacent work — Deformation spans simulation and visualization parameter settings, not a time-varying 3D scene or subject.</li><li>Introduces GS-Surrogate, a deformable Gaussian Splatting-based visualization surrogate for parameter-space exploration.</li><li>First constructs a canonical Gaussian field as a base 3D representation and adapts it through sequential parameter-conditioned deformations.</li></ol> |
| [GTAvatar: Bridging Gaussian Splatting and Texture Mapping for Relightable and Editable Gaussian Avatars](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.09162) (2025)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://kelianb.github.io/GTAvatar/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/KelianB/GTAvatar "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>avatar &middot; human &middot; monocular &middot; mesh-anchored &middot; relighting &middot; editing</sub> | <ol><li>Adjacent work — Reconstructs, relights, and texture-edits a canonical Gaussian head without temporal deformation or animation modeling.</li><li>Binds 2D Gaussian primitives to UV-mapped patches on a template mesh, linking splatting with conventional texture editing.</li><li>Learns continuous material textures and physically based appearance for relighting under new illumination.</li></ol> |
| [SUCCESS-GS: Survey of Compactness and Compression for Efficient Static and Dynamic Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.07197) (2025)<br><br><sub>data-benchmark &middot; native-4dgs &middot; real-time &middot; compression &middot; benchmark</sub> | <ol><li>Supporting resource — A mixed static-and-dynamic Gaussian compression survey; 4DGS is a substantial focus but not its exclusive scope.</li><li>Provides a unified survey of compact and efficient Gaussian splatting methods for both static 3D and dynamic 4D scenes.</li><li>Organizes prior work into parameter-compression and representation-restructuring approaches.</li></ol> |
| [TGSFormer: Scalable Temporal Gaussian Splatting for Embodied Semantic Scene Completion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.00300) (2025)<br><br><sub>tracking-slam &middot; segmentation &middot; per-scene</sub> | <ol><li>Adjacent work — Uses temporal Gaussian memory to fuse observations for semantic completion of a persistent environment, but does not model a time-varying scene or subject.</li><li>Uses scalable Temporal Gaussian Splatting for embodied SSC.</li><li>A Confidence-aware Voxel Fusion module merges overlapping primitives into voxel-aligned representations, regulating density and maintaining compactness.</li></ol> |
| [4DNeX: Feed-Forward 4D Generative Modeling Made Easy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.13154) (2025)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://4dnex.github.io/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/3DTopia/4DNeX "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>generation &middot; feed-forward &middot; monocular &middot; large-model &middot; native-4dgs</sub> | <ol><li>Adjacent work — Its feed-forward 4D output is a dynamic point cloud encoded as RGB-and-XYZ video, not Gaussian primitives.</li><li>Generates dynamic 3D scene representations from a single image using a feed-forward model fine-tuned from video diffusion.</li><li>Introduces 4DNeX-10M, a large-scale dataset of 4D annotations generated with reconstruction systems.</li></ol> |
| [PhysGaia: A Physics-Aware Benchmark with Multi-Body Interactions for Dynamic Novel View Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.02794) (2025)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://cv.snu.ac.kr/research/PhysGaia/ "Project page")<br><sub>data-benchmark &middot; dataset &middot; benchmark &middot; physics-aware &middot; synthetic &middot; multi-view</sub> | <ol><li>Supporting resource — The benchmark is representation-agnostic dynamic NVS, but it explicitly ships integration and reported results for recent 4DGS models rather than defining a Gaussian-sequence benchmark.</li><li>Introduces a physics-aware dynamic-view benchmark spanning 17 multi-body scenes and four material categories.</li><li>Provides synchronized multi-view imagery together with ground-truth particle trajectories and physical parameters.</li></ol> |
| [Advancing Dense Endoscopic Reconstruction with Gaussian Splatting-driven Surface Normal-aware Tracking and Mapping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.19319) (2025)<br><br>[![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/lastbasket/Endo-2DTAM "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>tracking-slam &middot; multi-view &middot; slam &middot; real-time &middot; tracking &middot; driving</sub> | <ol><li>Adjacent work — Endo-2DTAM uses 2D Gaussians as a geometrically accurate SLAM map but does not model a time-varying scene or subject; motion is camera tracking rather than dynamic Gaussian representation.</li><li>Introduces Endo-2DTAM, a real-time endoscopic SLAM system with 2D Gaussian Splatting (2DGS) to address these challenges.</li><li>The robust tracking module combines point-to-point and point-to-plane distance metrics, while the mapping module utilizes normal consistency and depth distortion to enhance surface reconstruction quality.</li></ol> |
| [DGS-SLAM: Gaussian Splatting SLAM in Dynamic Environment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.10722) (2024)<br><br>[![Non-functional or unverified GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-8c959f?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/kmk97/DGS-SLAM "Placeholder or documentation-only GitHub repository")<br><sub>tracking-slam &middot; slam &middot; tracking &middot; segmentation &middot; generation</sub> | <ol><li>Adjacent work — DGS-SLAM removes dynamic objects so that a static Gaussian map and camera trajectory remain; it does not retain or model the objects' time-varying Gaussian state.</li><li>Introduces Dynamic Gaussian Splatting SLAM (DGS-SLAM), the first dynamic SLAM framework built on the foundation of Gaussian Splatting.</li><li>Integrates Gaussian Splatting SLAM with a robust filtering process to handle dynamic objects throughout the entire pipeline, including Gaussian insertion and keyframe selection.</li></ol> |
| [DG-SLAM: Robust Dynamic Gaussian Splatting SLAM with Hybrid Pose Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.08373) (2024)<br><br>[![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/fudan-zvg/DG-SLAM "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>tracking-slam &middot; slam &middot; real-time &middot; tracking &middot; generation &middot; human</sub> | <ol><li>Adjacent work — DG-SLAM uses motion masks and Gaussian point management to make a static Gaussian SLAM map robust to distractors, rather than representing dynamic objects across time.</li><li>Introduces DG-SLAM, the first robust dynamic visual SLAM system grounded in 3D Gaussians, which provides precise camera pose estimation alongside reconstructions.</li><li>Introduces effective strategies, including motion mask generation, adaptive Gaussian point management, and a hybrid camera tracking algorithm to improve the accuracy and robustness of pose estimation.</li></ol> |
| [4K4D: Real-Time 4D View Synthesis at 4K Resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.11448) (2023)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://zju3dv.github.io/4k4d/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/zju3dv/4K4D "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>efficiency &middot; multi-view &middot; per-scene &middot; hybrid &middot; real-time</sub> | <ol><li>Adjacent work — 4K4D uses a 4D point-cloud and feature-grid representation with differentiable depth peeling, not Gaussian primitives.</li><li>Introduces a 4D point-cloud representation built on a 4D feature grid and compatible with hardware rasterization.</li><li>Introduces a hybrid appearance model to improve rendering quality while preserving efficiency.</li></ol> |
| [HumanRF: High-Fidelity Neural Radiance Fields for Humans in Motion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.06356) (2023)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://actors-hq.com/ "Project page")<br><sub>reconstruction &middot; multi-view &middot; human &middot; per-scene &middot; compression &middot; continuous-time</sub> | <ol><li>Adjacent work — HumanRF is a temporally factorized neural radiance-field method and does not use Gaussian primitives.</li><li>Introduces ActorsHQ: 12-megapixel multi-view footage from 160 cameras for 16 human-motion sequences with per-frame meshes.</li><li>Introduces HumanRF, a temporally factorized 4D neural representation for high-fidelity, compressed human-performance playback.</li></ol> |
| [Monocular Dynamic View Synthesis: A Reality Check](https://arxiv.org/abs/2210.13445) (2022)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://kair-bair.github.io/dycheck/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/KAIR-BAIR/dycheck "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>data-benchmark &middot; monocular &middot; tracking</sub> | <ol><li>Adjacent work — This is a general monocular dynamic-view benchmark and dataset predating 3DGS, not a Gaussian-specific evaluation.</li><li>Identifies multi-view signal leakage in dynamic-view-synthesis evaluation and defines effective multi-view factors for capture sequences.</li><li>Introduces co-visibility-masked image metrics and correspondence accuracy for evaluation.</li></ol> |
| [Efficient Neural Radiance Fields for Interactive Free-viewpoint Video](https://arxiv.org/abs/2112.01517) (2021)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://zju3dv.github.io/enerf/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/zju3dv/EasyVolcap "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>feed-forward &middot; multi-view &middot; depth-prior &middot; real-time</sub> | <ol><li>Adjacent work — ENeRF is a neural radiance-field method for free-viewpoint video and does not use Gaussian primitives.</li><li>Builds cascade cost volumes from multi-view images to predict coarse geometry.</li><li>Samples near predicted surfaces to reduce empty-space evaluation for interactive free-viewpoint video.</li></ol> |
| [HyperNeRF: A Higher-Dimensional Representation for Topologically Varying Neural Radiance Fields](https://arxiv.org/abs/2106.13228) (2021)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://hypernerf.github.io/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/google/hypernerf "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>reconstruction &middot; monocular &middot; per-scene &middot; continuous-time</sub> | <ol><li>Adjacent work — HyperNeRF models dynamic scenes as a higher-dimensional neural radiance field, not Gaussian splats.</li><li>Models topologically varying dynamic scenes by lifting a NeRF into a higher-dimensional hyperspace.</li><li>Represents each observed configuration as a slice through a 5D radiance field, avoiding discontinuous deformation mappings.</li></ol> |
| [Neural 3D Video Synthesis from Multi-view Video](https://arxiv.org/abs/2103.02597) (2021)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://neural-3d-video.github.io/ "Project page")<br><sub>reconstruction &middot; multi-view &middot; per-scene &middot; compression &middot; continuous-time</sub> | <ol><li>Adjacent work — Neural 3D Video uses a time-conditioned NeRF and latent codes rather than Gaussian primitives.</li><li>Represents dynamic multi-view video with a time-conditioned NeRF and compact latent codes.</li><li>Uses hierarchical training and ray importance sampling to improve training speed and perceptual quality.</li></ol> |
| [Neural Body: Implicit Neural Representations with Structured Latent Codes for Novel View Synthesis of Dynamic Humans](https://arxiv.org/abs/2012.15838) (2020)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://zju3dv.github.io/neuralbody/ "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/zju3dv/neuralbody "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>reconstruction &middot; multi-view &middot; human &middot; mesh-anchored &middot; per-scene</sub> | <ol><li>Adjacent work — Neural Body is an implicit neural human representation without Gaussian primitives.</li><li>Introduces a deformable-mesh-anchored latent representation that integrates observations across video frames for sparse-view human synthesis.</li><li>Releases ZJU-MoCap, a multi-view dataset of performers with complex motions.</li></ol> |
| [D-NeRF: Neural Radiance Fields for Dynamic Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2011.13961) (2020)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://www.albertpumarola.com/research/D-NeRF/index.html "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/albertpumarola/D-NeRF "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>reconstruction &middot; monocular &middot; per-scene &middot; continuous-time</sub> | <ol><li>Adjacent work — D-NeRF is a dynamic neural radiance field with canonical deformation, not Gaussian splatting.</li><li>Extends NeRF to dynamic scenes by making time an input and learning canonicalization and time-specific deformation mappings.</li><li>Reconstructs rigid, articulated, and non-rigid motion from a moving monocular camera.</li></ol> |

## Dataset and benchmark papers

| Paper (arXiv) | Key contributions |
| --- | --- |
| [3D Gaussian Splatting for Efficient Retrospective Dynamic Scene Novel View Synthesis with a Standardized Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.12437) (2026)<br><br><sub>data-benchmark &middot; multi-view &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; generation &middot; dataset &middot; benchmark</sub> | <ol><li>Posits that the availability of calibrated, synchronized viewpoints provides sufficient spatial consistency, and therefore, explicit temporal coupling, or complex multi-body constraints seems unnecessary for retrospective NVS.</li><li>Targets synchronized MV dynamic scene.</li><li>Initializes the SfM-derived point cloud at the start time and propagating optimized Gaussians over time and efficient retrospective NVS can be achieved without imposing a temporal deformation constraint.</li></ol> |
| [Bringing a Personal Point of View: Evaluating Dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting for Egocentric Scene Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.23803) (2026)<br><br><sub>data-benchmark &middot; monocular &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; human &middot; robotics &middot; dataset</sub> | <ol><li>Evaluates dynamic monocular 3DGS models on egocentric and exocentric video using paired ego-exo recordings from the EgoExo4D dataset.</li><li>Finds that reconstruction quality is consistently lower in egocentric views.</li><li>Analysis reveals that the difference in reconstruction quality, measured in peak signal-to-noise ratio, stems from the reconstruction of static, not dynamic, content.</li></ol> |
| [Realizing Immersive Volumetric Video: A Multimodal Framework for 6-DoF VR Engagement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09473) (2026)<br><br><sub>data-benchmark &middot; multi-view &middot; generation &middot; dataset &middot; benchmark</sub> | <ol><li>Defines immersive volumetric video and introduces ImViD, a synchronized multi-view audiovisual dataset covering complex indoor and outdoor dynamics.</li><li>Introduces a Gaussian spatiotemporal reconstruction pipeline with flow-guided initialization, temporal camera calibration, and joint supervision.</li><li>Adds sound-field reconstruction and evaluates temporally stable audiovisual playback across large six-degree-of-freedom viewing regions.</li></ol> |
| [Style4D-Bench: A Benchmark Suite for 4D Stylization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.19243) (2025)<br><br>[![Project page](https://img.shields.io/badge/-0969da?logo=googleearth&logoColor=white)](https://becky-catherine.github.io/Style4D "Project page") [![Functional GitHub repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/-1f883d?logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Becky-catherine/Style4D-Bench "Functional GitHub repository")<br><sub>data-benchmark &middot; multi-view &middot; native-4dgs &middot; editing &middot; benchmark</sub> | <ol><li>Defines a benchmark suite for standardized evaluation of 4D stylization.</li><li>Couples a base 4DGS scene representation with per-Gaussian MLPs for temporally and spatially aware appearance control.</li></ol> |
| [Monocular Dynamic Gaussian Splatting: Fast, Brittle, and Scene Complexity Rules](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.04457) (2024)<br><br><sub>data-benchmark &middot; monocular &middot; multi-view &middot; dataset &middot; benchmark &middot; synthetic</sub> | <ol><li>Organizes, benchmark, and analyze many Gaussian-splatting-based methods, providing apples-to-apples comparisons that prior works have lacked.</li><li>Uses multiple existing datasets and a new instructive synthetic dataset designed to isolate factors that affect reconstruction quality.</li><li>Categorizes Gaussian splatting methods into specific motion representation types and quantify how their differences impact performance.</li></ol> |

## Datasets

Benchmarks used for training or evaluation by at least eight scope-audited direct dynamic-Gaussian papers. Names are
normalized across common aliases; **Data / Project** points to an official source when one is
available. **Data license** reports explicit dataset terms; `Repository:` applies only to the linked repository. `Not stated` means no terms were found, `Not verified` means no official page is recorded, and `Unverified` means the check failed. **Scale** preserves source-reported units because a frame may mean a timestamp, per-camera image, or aggregate count. Lower-adoption datasets remain searchable in the JSON and SQLite metadata; citation-only mentions do not count.
